EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Damas–Milner theorem for its language, Wells undecidability for Curry-style System F and Mairson worst-case lower bound; no average performance or universal inference result.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.TRANSFERABILITY_LIMITS: Principal inference results concern restricted fragments; richer inference can be undecidable and even decidable ML inference has exponential worst cases.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.UNVERIFIED_OR_OPEN_QUESTIONS: Fragment membership or environment generalization unknown; algorithm resource limit reached or unsupported extension encountered. See lane open questions for source-access and implementation gaps.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.NEXT_DISCRIMINATOR: Use a checked derivation and fragment-specific soundness/completeness theorem; measure actual inference costs without extrapolating asymptotic lower bounds to ordinary programs. Supply missing inference_problem / inference_result_and_cost evidence before strengthening the verdict.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: The inspected foundations narrative stops after the semantics branch. It gives no substantive branch treatment of type systems or effects/resources/protocols, despite declaring B02–B08 coverage and 24 resolved properties. These records exist in a.json but C13 requires an integrated argument in the human report, not only ledger rows.

The normalized access-level enum contradicts the actual inspected portions in several records. SB034, SB039 and SB064 are labeled RELEVANT_SECTIONS_INSPECTED although each explicitly records only abstract/metadata access and failed body retrieval. Conversely SA030 is METADATA_ONLY even though its cited 1994 source theorem/definition sections were inspected; only the separately mentioned 1999 version was metadata-only. The aggregate access counts therefore are not counts of the stated source access. The explanatory normalization note does not repair an inaccurate machine value.

The generic negative-case verdict conflates failure of the retained predicate with failure of a stronger implication. XA10 gives a well-typed, safe function returning zero that violates an intended increment requirement; C0010-P01 deliberately claims only avoidance of Bad_L. XA12 gives a function satisfying its encoded postcondition result=0 but not the intended increment; C0012-P01 is the relative formal-specification claim. In both cases the retained predicate can remain true, yet EXPECTED_A_P_E.NEGATIVE assigns A=true, P=false and E=FAIL. The phrase for the precise violated rule/overclaim does not identify a separate overclaim predicate and leaves the case evaluator capable of falsely failing the retained property. Analogous ambiguity occurs where unauthorized effects, uncalibrated physical time or out-of-fragment seq refute only additional inferences.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: No listed finding is not a guarantee of correctness; reviewers and their sampled documentary checks are described in the validation report.

INTAKE.CROSSWALK_ELIGIBILITY_WITH_REASON: Eligible as a conditional candidate with explicit evidence ceiling; rejected/ceremonial records are retained as failure boundaries rather than favorable recommendations.
TARGET_NEUTRAL_AUDIT_QUESTIONS: What exact bearer and version are covered by Principal inference within an explicit decidable fragment?
Which observation/evaluator could establish the rule, and which missing premise yields UNKNOWN?
What demonstrates inference_problem and inference_result_and_cost rather than a label or empty accepted corpus?
Would the stated cheaper path achieve the actual consumer objective?
PROHIBITED_OVERCLAIMS: Principal inference results concern restricted fragments; richer inference can be undecidable and even decidable ML inference has exponential worst cases.
No claim that a proof, parser, graph, type, capability label or static check establishes natural-language intention without a separate validated bridge.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A named value-dependent invariant matters enough to warrant annotation/proof burden.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Known non-trigger: No specific value-dependent obligation is both required and represented in the assessed formal type/specification; for example, the claim concerns only a plain shape type and makes no value-level contract claim. Lower-cost option already recorded: Ordinary algebraic types plus a local runtime bounds check are adequate when the remaining failure cost and frequency permit it. PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: Specification-bearing refinement and dependent type checking: Richer types can establish explicitly encoded value/relational obligations when their logic, termination and solver/kernel assumptions hold; the encoded specification still needs independent justification.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For every admitted instance/transition explicitly covered by the stated rule and applicability guard; a worked example is not evidence for all programs. A proof establishes the encoded proposition in a formal model, not that the proposition matches stakeholder intent or all physical execution behavior.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: Program, formal specification/type, logical theory and proof/checking evidence.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Evaluate against the recorded version/environment; execution/transition statements range over the rule's modeled executions, while current evidence is a dated observation. For refinement {v:T | φ(v)}, acceptance requires a valid derivation/entailment that executions covered by the theorem produce T-values satisfying φ. For dependent proof terms, check the exact proposition and axioms. If only partial correctness is established, do not infer termination.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Specification is well-formed and reviewed; theorem logic is consistent under admitted axioms; totality/partial-correctness meaning is explicit; trusted solver/kernel contracts hold.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A(e): a specific value-dependent obligation is required and represented in the formal type/specification.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: For refinement {v:T | φ(v)}, acceptance requires a valid derivation/entailment that executions covered by the theorem produce T-values satisfying φ. For dependent proof terms, check the exact proposition and axioms. If only partial correctness is established, do not infer termination.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.NOTE: This operational rule is a synthesis for intake evaluation, not a formula quoted from a source theorem; source theorems remain bounded by their own language and hypotheses.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Inspect specification and its variable/unit interpretation; Check proof/kernel evidence and review executable/specification mapping. Map these values into the rule without substituting a successful tool exit for semantic truth.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Specification is well-formed and reviewed; theorem logic is consistent under admitted axioms; totality/partial-correctness meaning is explicit; trusted solver/kernel contracts hold. Required witness data: encoded_obligation and proof_trust_and_coverage.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Kernel/type-check proof or validate solver proof/entailment in the stated theory; separately review specification against concrete intended examples and counterexamples.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: The finite instance/trace checks described by the evaluator may be executable. Quantification over all programs, contexts or executions requires the source's restricted theorem/proof; finite testing is incomplete, and timeout yields UNKNOWN.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Constructed: a vector append function with lengths m,n returns length m+n under a checked length specification.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Constructed: a function returning 0 can satisfy the formally encoded but mistaken postcondition result=0 even when the intended requirement is increment.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Missing proof, unsupported logical theory, solver timeout, admitted axiom not accepted by the consumer or unvalidated specification mapping. Missing evidence is not evidence that the guard is false. If A is already known true, an unestablished model, premise, proof or coverage leaves the operational judgment UNKNOWN through P/E; if a fact needed to decide A itself is unknown, report A=UNKNOWN. Only an established false A permits INAPPLICABLE.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No specific value-dependent obligation is both required and represented in the assessed formal type/specification; for example, the claim concerns only a plain shape type and makes no value-level contract claim.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False positive: treating an incomplete boundary/proxy as the whole claim (An inconsistent or incorrect specification is treated as intent; unchecked axioms, solver assumptions or divergence undermine the promised interpretation.). False negative: rejecting a valid instance because a conservative analysis or restricted proof language cannot express it; distinguish analyzer rejection from demonstrated semantic failure.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: A checker that rejects everything, empty accepted corpus, erased error nodes, or an observation model that omits the disputed behavior can make apparent success vacuous. Expressive types can shift error and effort into the specification and produce rejection or proof burden disproportionate to the decision.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Refinement, dependent index, logic/axiom set, solver/kernel, numeric semantics, program or library specification changes.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Specifications/qualifiers, proof automation failures, annotations, solver trust, maintenance and comprehensible diagnostics. Cheaper path: Ordinary algebraic types plus a local runtime bounds check are adequate when the remaining failure cost and frequency permit it. Applicability and evidence limit: Ordinary algebraic types plus a local runtime check may be adequate for a narrower dynamic contract. If the stated value-dependent obligation is still represented and claimed, A remains true; PASS under this predicate still requires its valid derivation/entailment and covered-execution premises. A runtime check alone does not automatically establish a refinement/dependent-type proof.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Formal rule systems and a bounded Liquid Types benchmark; no general productivity superiority or automatic correct requirements.

FORMALISATION_PROVENANCE.LIMIT: The intake predicate is not represented as a published universal theorem.

APPLICABILITY_A.TRUE: A(e): a specific value-dependent obligation is required and represented in the formal type/specification.
APPLICABILITY_A.FALSE: No specific value-dependent obligation is both required and represented in the assessed formal type/specification; for example, the claim concerns only a plain shape type and makes no value-level contract claim.
APPLICABILITY_A.UNKNOWN: The truth of the applicability guard itself is not established. When the guard is known true, missing model/premise/proof/coverage evidence belongs to unresolved P/E and yields overall UNKNOWN, not A=false. Specific evidence gaps: Missing proof, unsupported logical theory, solver timeout, admitted axiom not accepted by the consumer or unvalidated specification mapping.

PROPERTY_P.TRUE: The precise rule holds for the stated model/instance and quantified scope.
PROPERTY_P.FALSE: A counterexample within the guard violates the rule.
PROPERTY_P.UNDETERMINED: Truth is not settled by available observation or proof; it is not inferred from missing evidence.

OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION.CURRENT_EVALUATION: Schema and constructed witnesses only; no target instance was evaluated.

EVALUATOR_OUTCOMES.PASS: Adequate, current evidence establishes P for the declared scope and A is true.
EVALUATOR_OUTCOMES.FAIL: Adequate counterevidence establishes a violation with A true.
EVALUATOR_OUTCOMES.UNKNOWN: A or P is unresolved, evidence stale, solver times out or scope is incomplete.
EVALUATOR_OUTCOMES.INAPPLICABLE: No specific value-dependent obligation is both required and represented in the assessed formal type/specification; for example, the claim concerns only a plain shape type and makes no value-level contract claim.

EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENCY_E.SIGNATURE: E_p(evidence, target={the named predicate=true or the named predicate=false}, scope) -> adequacy judgment
EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENCY_E.SUFFICIENT: The evidence, its provenance, coverage and evaluator soundness conditions justify that specifically named truth/falsity verdict in the declared scope.
EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENCY_E.INSUFFICIENT_OR_UNKNOWN: The required premise, observation, source/implementation bridge or evaluator coverage is missing or unresolved. This does not decide predicate truth.
EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENCY_E.NEGATIVE_WITNESS_RULE: A valid counterexample to the actual predicate can establish predicate=false with adequate evidence and overall evaluator FAIL. Evidence refuting only a stronger overclaim does not establish the retained predicate=false.
EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENCY_E.LIMIT: Adequacy for one target/scope does not establish a different predicate, unrestricted truth or the original candidate if the named predicate instead tests its critique.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: The inspected foundations narrative stops after the semantics branch. It gives no substantive branch treatment of type systems or effects/resources/protocols, despite declaring B02–B08 coverage and 24 resolved properties. These records exist in a.json but C13 requires an integrated argument in the human report, not only ledger rows.

The generic negative-case verdict conflates failure of the retained predicate with failure of a stronger implication. XA10 gives a well-typed, safe function returning zero that violates an intended increment requirement; C0010-P01 deliberately claims only avoidance of Bad_L. XA12 gives a function satisfying its encoded postcondition result=0 but not the intended increment; C0012-P01 is the relative formal-specification claim. In both cases the retained predicate can remain true, yet EXPECTED_A_P_E.NEGATIVE assigns A=true, P=false and E=FAIL. The phrase for the precise violated rule/overclaim does not identify a separate overclaim predicate and leaves the case evaluator capable of falsely failing the retained property. Analogous ambiguity occurs where unauthorized effects, uncalibrated physical time or out-of-fragment seq refute only additional inferences.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: No listed finding is not a guarantee of correctness; reviewers and their sampled documentary checks are described in the validation report.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: The inspected foundations narrative stops after the semantics branch. It gives no substantive branch treatment of type systems or effects/resources/protocols, despite declaring B02–B08 coverage and 24 resolved properties. These records exist in a.json but C13 requires an integrated argument in the human report, not only ledger rows.

The generic negative-case verdict conflates failure of the retained predicate with failure of a stronger implication. XA10 gives a well-typed, safe function returning zero that violates an intended increment requirement; C0010-P01 deliberately claims only avoidance of Bad_L. XA12 gives a function satisfying its encoded postcondition result=0 but not the intended increment; C0012-P01 is the relative formal-specification claim. In both cases the retained predicate can remain true, yet EXPECTED_A_P_E.NEGATIVE assigns A=true, P=false and E=FAIL. The phrase for the precise violated rule/overclaim does not identify a separate overclaim predicate and leaves the case evaluator capable of falsely failing the retained property. Analogous ambiguity occurs where unauthorized effects, uncalibrated physical time or out-of-fragment seq refute only additional inferences.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: No listed finding is not a guarantee of correctness; reviewers and their sampled documentary checks are described in the validation report.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: The inspected foundations narrative stops after the semantics branch. It gives no substantive branch treatment of type systems or effects/resources/protocols, despite declaring B02–B08 coverage and 24 resolved properties. These records exist in a.json but C13 requires an integrated argument in the human report, not only ledger rows.

The generic negative-case verdict conflates failure of the retained predicate with failure of a stronger implication. XA10 gives a well-typed, safe function returning zero that violates an intended increment requirement; C0010-P01 deliberately claims only avoidance of Bad_L. XA12 gives a function satisfying its encoded postcondition result=0 but not the intended increment; C0012-P01 is the relative formal-specification claim. In both cases the retained predicate can remain true, yet EXPECTED_A_P_E.NEGATIVE assigns A=true, P=false and E=FAIL. The phrase for the precise violated rule/overclaim does not identify a separate overclaim predicate and leaves the case evaluator capable of falsely failing the retained property. Analogous ambiguity occurs where unauthorized effects, uncalibrated physical time or out-of-fragment seq refute only additional inferences.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: No listed finding is not a guarantee of correctness; reviewers and their sampled documentary checks are described in the validation report.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Resources have lifetime, ownership or aliasing obligations that matter to correctness or optimization.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Known non-trigger: The assessed program manipulates no ownership, linear or borrowed resource covered by the claimed discipline; for example, ordinary immutable shared values are managed by GC and no ownership/linearity claim is made. Applicability and evidence limit: GC-managed immutable sharing can avoid a separate ownership discipline when the claim is actually limited accordingly. If a resource is still covered by the claimed ownership/linear/borrow discipline, simplicity or GC does not discharge its invariant automatically; adequate evidence must establish that exact discipline.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Operational alias model matches the checker guarantees; primitive/unsafe/foreign contracts hold; concurrency obligations are included when claimed. Required witness data: resource_permission_state and escape_and_model_coverage.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: The finite instance/trace checks described by the evaluator may be executable. Quantification over all programs, contexts or executions requires the source's restricted theorem/proof; finite testing is incomplete, and timeout yields UNKNOWN.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Constructed: a mutable borrow is exclusive for its declared interval; accesses through conflicting aliases are excluded by the specified rules.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Published composition witness: a multi-shot effect handler can duplicate a continuation using a linear file; ordinary value-linearity alone is insufficient. An unchecked unsafe library can also violate a safe caller guarantee.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Alias model, foreign semantics, unsafe abstraction proof or data-race reasoning outside verified framework unavailable. Missing evidence is not evidence that the guard is false. If A is already known true, an unestablished model, premise, proof or coverage leaves the operational judgment UNKNOWN through P/E; if a fact needed to decide A itself is unknown, report A=UNKNOWN. Only an established false A permits INAPPLICABLE.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: The assessed program manipulates no ownership, linear or borrowed resource covered by the claimed discipline; for example, ordinary immutable shared values are managed by GC and no ownership/linearity claim is made.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False positive: treating an incomplete boundary/proxy as the whole claim (Treating linearity as uniqueness, aliasing models as borrow checkers, or safe caller syntax as proof of a sound unsafe/FFI implementation.). False negative: rejecting a valid instance because a conservative analysis or restricted proof language cannot express it; distinguish analyzer rejection from demonstrated semantic failure.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: A checker that rejects everything, empty accepted corpus, erased error nodes, or an observation model that omits the disputed behavior can make apparent success vacuous. Restrictive rules reject useful programs; a more permissive alias model must still justify optimizations, and formal coverage can stop before real FFI/concurrency behavior.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Checker/rules, unsafe code, FFI, lifetime assumptions, alias model, optimizer or concurrency semantics change.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Borrow checker restrictions, lifetime/permission annotations, redesign to satisfy checks, unsafe proofs and migration between alias models. Applicability and evidence limit: GC-managed immutable sharing can avoid a separate ownership discipline when the claim is actually limited accordingly. RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: The inspected foundations narrative stops after the semantics branch. It gives no substantive branch treatment of type systems or effects/resources/protocols, despite declaring B02–B08 coverage and 24 resolved properties. These records exist in a.json but C13 requires an integrated argument in the human report, not only ledger rows.

The generic negative-case verdict conflates failure of the retained predicate with failure of a stronger implication. XA10 gives a well-typed, safe function returning zero that violates an intended increment requirement; C0010-P01 deliberately claims only avoidance of Bad_L. XA12 gives a function satisfying its encoded postcondition result=0 but not the intended increment; C0012-P01 is the relative formal-specification claim. In both cases the retained predicate can remain true, yet EXPECTED_A_P_E.NEGATIVE assigns A=true, P=false and E=FAIL. The phrase for the precise violated rule/overclaim does not identify a separate overclaim predicate and leaves the case evaluator capable of falsely failing the retained property. Analogous ambiguity occurs where unauthorized effects, uncalibrated physical time or out-of-fragment seq refute only additional inferences.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Capability security models describe authority-bearing references; language capture checking can track retained capabilities but solves a different static obligation.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: An authority-bearing capability works only when actual access is mediated by its unforgeable/validated reference and delegation/attenuation rules; a token-shaped value or type annotation alone is insufficient.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.CLAIM_CLASS: Conditional engineering property derived from formal mechanisms and their boundaries
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: Capability reference, subject/resource operation, authority graph and enforcing runtime boundary.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A copyable key analogy ignores controlled delegation; ambient access bypasses mediation; a live-looking identifier refers to revoked/stale authority.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Require the appropriate capability at the operation; constrain creation/delegation, attenuate authority through interfaces, and implement revocation through mediated indirection where claimed.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Keep designation and authority aligned, expose narrow operations, record delegation/revocation semantics and verify enforcement paths; treat static capture as complementary.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Authority use and delegation can be scoped to explicit references and narrower interfaces under the selected capability model.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Mechanistic/formal support: An object-capability argument requires unforgeable references and complete mediation of relevant authority; capture sets alone do not implement those conditions. No direct comparative engineering-payoff experiment for this whole reconstructed property is established.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Untrusted/separately privileged components delegate or exercise authority over resources.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: A single trusted component with an adequate centralized access check may not need a full object-capability architecture; local runtime handle validation may suffice.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Untrusted/separately privileged components delegate or exercise authority over resources.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Known non-trigger: The assessed operation is not an authority-controlled action across the stated trust boundary; for example, pure local arithmetic performs no protected action. Lower-cost option already recorded: A single trusted component with an adequate centralized access check may not need a full object-capability architecture; local runtime handle validation may suffice. Applicability and evidence limit: A single validated handle check or centralized mediation point can cheaply satisfy the applicable capability rule if it covers all access paths, identity and delegation/attenuation premises. Being in a small trusted component does not remove an authority boundary that the claim still crosses.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Every relevant access path is mediated; capabilities cannot be forged through the available language/runtime; delegation/ambient/foreign channels match the threat model.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Authority possession is distinct from a policy saying who ought to receive it, effect possibility, resource lifetime and actual completion of an operation.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: An object-capability argument requires unforgeable references and complete mediation of relevant authority; capture sets alone do not implement those conditions.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Source language definitions/theorems or tool contracts are authoritative only within their versioned scope. This reconstructed research property is not a normative requirement for any target.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Record exact input/model, language/tool version, dependencies, evaluator, observation method and source locators; separate constructed examples, source proofs and observed tool outcomes. Uninspected access path, foreign/ambient authority, revocation propagation or resource identity mapping.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: The inspected foundations narrative stops after the semantics branch. It gives no substantive branch treatment of type systems or effects/resources/protocols, despite declaring B02–B08 coverage and 24 resolved properties. These records exist in a.json but C13 requires an integrated argument in the human report, not only ledger rows.

The generic negative-case verdict conflates failure of the retained predicate with failure of a stronger implication. XA10 gives a well-typed, safe function returning zero that violates an intended increment requirement; C0010-P01 deliberately claims only avoidance of Bad_L. XA12 gives a function satisfying its encoded postcondition result=0 but not the intended increment; C0012-P01 is the relative formal-specification claim. In both cases the retained predicate can remain true, yet EXPECTED_A_P_E.NEGATIVE assigns A=true, P=false and E=FAIL. The phrase for the precise violated rule/overclaim does not identify a separate overclaim predicate and leaves the case evaluator capable of falsely failing the retained property. Analogous ambiguity occurs where unauthorized effects, uncalibrated physical time or out-of-fragment seq refute only additional inferences.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: The inspected foundations narrative stops after the semantics branch. It gives no substantive branch treatment of type systems or effects/resources/protocols, despite declaring B02–B08 coverage and 24 resolved properties. These records exist in a.json but C13 requires an integrated argument in the human report, not only ledger rows.

The generic negative-case verdict conflates failure of the retained predicate with failure of a stronger implication. XA10 gives a well-typed, safe function returning zero that violates an intended increment requirement; C0010-P01 deliberately claims only avoidance of Bad_L. XA12 gives a function satisfying its encoded postcondition result=0 but not the intended increment; C0012-P01 is the relative formal-specification claim. In both cases the retained predicate can remain true, yet EXPECTED_A_P_E.NEGATIVE assigns A=true, P=false and E=FAIL. The phrase for the precise violated rule/overclaim does not identify a separate overclaim predicate and leaves the case evaluator capable of falsely failing the retained property. Analogous ambiguity occurs where unauthorized effects, uncalibrated physical time or out-of-fragment seq refute only additional inferences.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For every admitted instance/transition explicitly covered by the stated rule and applicability guard; a worked example is not evidence for all programs. Upper bound differs from tightness, lower/average bound and physical latency. Termination follows only under a theorem/metric charging sufficient progress, not from every resource bound.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: Program, input-size abstraction, resource potential and costed execution model.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Evaluate against the recorded version/environment; execution/transition statements range over the rule's modeled executions, while current evidence is a dated observation. For initial potential Φ(input) and residual potential Ψ(result), every covered finite execution prefix consumes at most the available potential under cost_M; for terminating runs account for residual potential as the theorem states. PhysicalBudget follows only with a justified bound from cost_M to physical cost.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Cost constants/metric and size abstraction match the intended bound; all modeled paths/control transfers accounted for; solver/type derivation is valid; compiler/runtime correspondence is established if physical costs are claimed.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A(p): a named quantitative resource metric and bound are required for p.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: For initial potential Φ(input) and residual potential Ψ(result), every covered finite execution prefix consumes at most the available potential under cost_M; for terminating runs account for residual potential as the theorem states. PhysicalBudget follows only with a justified bound from cost_M to physical cost.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.NOTE: This operational rule is a synthesis for intake evaluation, not a formula quoted from a source theorem; source theorems remain bounded by their own language and hypotheses.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Inspect cost rules and calibrate only if making a physical claim; Validate potential/constraints against the costed semantics. Map these values into the rule without substituting a successful tool exit for semantic truth.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Cost constants/metric and size abstraction match the intended bound; all modeled paths/control transfers accounted for; solver/type derivation is valid; compiler/runtime correspondence is established if physical costs are claimed. Required witness data: cost_semantics and resource_certificate.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Check type/potential derivation and solver constraints, then establish any required metric-to-runtime correspondence; independently measure selected runs for model calibration, not universal proof.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: The finite instance/trace checks described by the evaluator may be executable. Quantification over all programs, contexts or executions requires the source's restricted theorem/proof; finite testing is incomplete, and timeout yields UNKNOWN.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Constructed: a list traversal charges one tick per element and a checked potential n covers that metric for a list of length n.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Constructed: n abstract steps do not bound elapsed seconds while each step can block on external I/O; a zero-cost metric cannot prove termination.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Cost constants, input-size map, effect-handler accounting, compiler correspondence or solver evidence missing. Missing evidence is not evidence that the guard is false. If A is already known true, an unestablished model, premise, proof or coverage leaves the operational judgment UNKNOWN through P/E; if a fact needed to decide A itself is unknown, report A=UNKNOWN. Only an established false A permits INAPPLICABLE.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No named quantitative resource metric and bound are required for the assessed program; for example, a result is requested without any resource-bound claim.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False positive: treating an incomplete boundary/proxy as the whole claim (A bound in abstract ticks is called wall-clock timing; inferred upper bound confused with tightness/average cost; exceptions or multi-shot control consume unaccounted potential.). False negative: rejecting a valid instance because a conservative analysis or restricted proof language cannot express it; distinguish analyzer rejection from demonstrated semantic failure.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: A checker that rejects everything, empty accepted corpus, erased error nodes, or an observation model that omits the disputed behavior can make apparent success vacuous. Automatic sound analysis is incomplete; selected polynomial bases cannot express all bounds and an inaccurate metric yields an irrelevant certificate.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Program/control-flow, cost constants, input representation, compiler/lowering, resource metric, solver or external cost model changes.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Potential annotations, whole-program constraints, LP solver trust, model calibration and unsupported function/bound shapes. Cheaper path: Profiling with runtime quotas can suffice for a bounded low-consequence workload; ordinary memory management does not require a polynomial resource proof. Applicability and evidence limit: Profiling or a trusted runtime quota may be adequate for the actual bounded measurement/enforcement target. A remains true when a resource bound is required. PASS for this predicate requires evidence for its exact cost model and bound; observed samples or a different enforcement contract do not automatically establish a universal potential/cost proof.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: AARA model-relative soundness and bounded author benchmarks; no universal tight bound, all-program inference or unconditional wall-clock guarantee.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: The inspected foundations narrative stops after the semantics branch. It gives no substantive branch treatment of type systems or effects/resources/protocols, despite declaring B02–B08 coverage and 24 resolved properties. These records exist in a.json but C13 requires an integrated argument in the human report, not only ledger rows.

The generic negative-case verdict conflates failure of the retained predicate with failure of a stronger implication. XA10 gives a well-typed, safe function returning zero that violates an intended increment requirement; C0010-P01 deliberately claims only avoidance of Bad_L. XA12 gives a function satisfying its encoded postcondition result=0 but not the intended increment; C0012-P01 is the relative formal-specification claim. In both cases the retained predicate can remain true, yet EXPECTED_A_P_E.NEGATIVE assigns A=true, P=false and E=FAIL. The phrase for the precise violated rule/overclaim does not identify a separate overclaim predicate and leaves the case evaluator capable of falsely failing the retained property. Analogous ambiguity occurs where unauthorized effects, uncalibrated physical time or out-of-fragment seq refute only additional inferences.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: No listed finding is not a guarantee of correctness; reviewers and their sampled documentary checks are described in the validation report.

INTAKE.CROSSWALK_ELIGIBILITY_WITH_REASON: Eligible as a conditional candidate with explicit evidence ceiling; rejected/ceremonial records are retained as failure boundaries rather than favorable recommendations.

Which observation/evaluator could establish the rule, and which missing premise yields UNKNOWN?

Would the stated cheaper path achieve the actual consumer objective?

No claim that a proof, parser, graph, type, capability label or static check establishes natural-language intention without a separate validated bridge.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: Evaluate this finite proposed witness against the exact candidate and its declared domain. One valid counterexample defeats a universal implication; it does not establish prevalence or disprove narrower conditional mechanisms.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: Any proposed subject and consumer, including records, cyclic references, behavior and human intentions.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Evaluate against the recorded version/environment; execution/transition statements range over the rule's modeled executions, while current evidence is a dated observation. The proposal ∀subjects s, AST(s) alone is adequate for every relevant consumer is refuted when a consumer distinguishes sharing, cycles, source trivia, external interpretation or temporal behavior absent from the tree. Legitimate AST use instead requires the EPLT-C0003 consumer-specific contract.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: The bounded legitimate use requires a syntactic subject, a tree-compatible decomposition and an actual consumer; otherwise the claimed general rule has no mechanism.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: A consumer-specific witness defeats the universal architecture prescription when its goal and necessary distinctions are explicit, an alternative representation adequately supports that goal, and mandatory AST conversion adds no required mechanism or loses required identity/fidelity without a justified bridge. This is a qualitative necessity test, not a claimed source-authored theorem over every engineering subject.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.NOTE: This operational rule is a synthesis for intake evaluation, not a formula quoted from a source theorem; source theorems remain bounded by their own language and hypotheses.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Ask which operation would fail or become materially harder without it; Inventory required conversions and consumer-used invariants. Map these values into the rule without substituting a successful tool exit for semantic truth.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: The bounded legitimate use requires a syntactic subject, a tree-compatible decomposition and an actual consumer; otherwise the claimed general rule has no mechanism. Required witness data: consumer_requirement and representation_burden.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Identify the actual consumer and construct a distinction it needs that the AST omits; compare the cheapest adequate existing representation.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: The finite instance/trace checks described by the evaluator may be executable. Quantification over all programs, contexts or executions requires the source's restricted theorem/proof; finite testing is incomplete, and timeout yields UNKNOWN.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: A valid refutation witness: Constructed: a two-state protocol contains a self-loop; its transition graph can be encoded with tree references, but the AST shape alone neither states the transition semantics nor proves temporal obligations.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: An alternative representation that fails the actual consumer requirement does not demonstrate that AST conversion is unnecessary for that consumer; a useful AST case does not establish a universal mandate.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: No consumer or intended semantics supplied: benefit and adequacy are UNKNOWN, not established by successfully creating a tree. Missing evidence is not evidence that the guard is false. If A is already known true, an unestablished model, premise, proof or coverage leaves the operational judgment UNKNOWN through P/E; if a fact needed to decide A itself is unknown, report A=UNKNOWN. Only an established false A permits INAPPLICABLE.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: Neither a universal AST mandate nor an AST-as-sufficient-semantics claim is advanced; for example, an AST is chosen for one justified consumer without a universal mandate.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False positive: treating an incomplete boundary/proxy as the whole claim (Extra conversion/normalization work replaces semantic interpretation; cyclic/shared entities and temporal obligations are flattened without adequate identity or semantics.). False negative: rejecting a valid instance because a conservative analysis or restricted proof language cannot express it; distinguish analyzer rejection from demonstrated semantic failure.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: A checker that rejects everything, empty accepted corpus, erased error nodes, or an observation model that omits the disputed behavior can make apparent success vacuous. An AST represents abstract syntax, not automatically binding, aliasing, concurrency, obligations or validated meaning.

Applicability and evidence limit: A table, schema, transition relation, CST or direct function may be a cheap adequate representation. When the universal mandate is advanced, such an alternative can provide a valid refutation witness and hence PASS for the critique predicate, never PASS for the universal mandate.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: The evidence partition machine values positively label the rejected candidate proposition as SUPPORTED, although the same partition limits and the retention status reject it. The evidence target is not separated from the original candidate.

The generic negative-case verdict conflates failure of the retained predicate with failure of a stronger implication. XA10 gives a well-typed, safe function returning zero that violates an intended increment requirement; C0010-P01 deliberately claims only avoidance of Bad_L. XA12 gives a function satisfying its encoded postcondition result=0 but not the intended increment; C0012-P01 is the relative formal-specification claim. In both cases the retained predicate can remain true, yet EXPECTED_A_P_E.NEGATIVE assigns A=true, P=false and E=FAIL. The phrase for the precise violated rule/overclaim does not identify a separate overclaim predicate and leaves the case evaluator capable of falsely failing the retained property. Analogous ambiguity occurs where unauthorized effects, uncalibrated physical time or out-of-fragment seq refute only additional inferences.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

Missing R or an invalid typing derivation makes this witness insufficient.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.NOTE: This operational rule is a synthesis for intake evaluation, not a formula quoted from a source theorem; source theorems remain bounded by their own language and hypotheses.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Inspect the type and theorem, without adding implicit requirements; Compare behavior to an independently stated requirement. Map these values into the rule without substituting a successful tool exit for semantic truth.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Exhibit a well-typed executable counterexample against a specified requirement; distinguish wrong result from type error.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: A valid refutation witness: Constructed: f(x:Int):Int = 0 is type correct and total but fails f(x)=x+1 at x=0.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: An ill-typed program with a wrong result is not a valid witness against the ordinary-well-typedness implication; the witness must actually satisfy the ordinary type judgment.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: If external requirement R is absent or ambiguous, intended-function conformance is UNKNOWN regardless of typing. Missing evidence is not evidence that the guard is false. If A is already known true, an unestablished model, premise, proof or coverage leaves the operational judgment UNKNOWN through P/E; if a fact needed to decide A itself is unknown, report A=UNKNOWN. Only an established false A permits INAPPLICABLE.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: Ordinary typing is not claimed to establish intended-function correctness; for example, types justify a shape/safety result and functional requirements are assessed separately.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False positive: treating an incomplete boundary/proxy as the whole claim (A total safe function returns the wrong integer, chooses a wrong branch, omits a required action or implements the wrong policy.). False negative: rejecting a valid instance because a conservative analysis or restricted proof language cannot express it; distinguish analyzer rejection from demonstrated semantic failure.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: A checker that rejects everything, empty accepted corpus, erased error nodes, or an observation model that omits the disputed behavior can make apparent success vacuous. Many distinct functions share the same ordinary type, including functions that disagree on every relevant requirement.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: A changed requirement can invalidate correctness while the ordinary type remains identical.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: False assurance and omitted requirement validation; richer proofs also cost specification/maintenance effort. If ordinary typing is still promoted to intended correctness, a cheap well-typed wrong-function witness can satisfy the refutation predicate; missing or ambiguous requirements leave the assessment UNKNOWN.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: The evidence partition machine values positively label the rejected candidate proposition as SUPPORTED, although the same partition limits and the retention status reject it. The evidence target is not separated from the original candidate.

The inspected foundations narrative stops after the semantics branch. It gives no substantive branch treatment of type systems or effects/resources/protocols, despite declaring B02–B08 coverage and 24 resolved properties. These records exist in a.json but C13 requires an integrated argument in the human report, not only ledger rows.

The generic negative-case verdict conflates failure of the retained predicate with failure of a stronger implication. XA10 gives a well-typed, safe function returning zero that violates an intended increment requirement; C0010-P01 deliberately claims only avoidance of Bad_L. XA12 gives a function satisfying its encoded postcondition result=0 but not the intended increment; C0012-P01 is the relative formal-specification claim. In both cases the retained predicate can remain true, yet EXPECTED_A_P_E.NEGATIVE assigns A=true, P=false and E=FAIL. The phrase for the precise violated rule/overclaim does not identify a separate overclaim predicate and leaves the case evaluator capable of falsely failing the retained property. Analogous ambiguity occurs where unauthorized effects, uncalibrated physical time or out-of-fragment seq refute only additional inferences.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: No listed finding is not a guarantee of correctness; reviewers and their sampled documentary checks are described in the validation report.

INTAKE.CROSSWALK_ELIGIBILITY_WITH_REASON: Eligible as a conditional candidate with explicit evidence ceiling; rejected/ceremonial records are retained as failure boundaries rather than favorable recommendations.

Which observation/evaluator could establish the rule, and which missing premise yields UNKNOWN?
What demonstrates ordinary_type_claim and intended_function_discriminator rather than a label or empty accepted corpus?
Would the stated cheaper path achieve the actual consumer objective?

No claim that a proof, parser, graph, type, capability label or static check establishes natural-language intention without a separate validated bridge.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: The inspected foundations narrative stops after the semantics branch. It gives no substantive branch treatment of type systems or effects/resources/protocols, despite declaring B02–B08 coverage and 24 resolved properties. These records exist in a.json but C13 requires an integrated argument in the human report, not only ledger rows.

The generic negative-case verdict conflates failure of the retained predicate with failure of a stronger implication. XA10 gives a well-typed, safe function returning zero that violates an intended increment requirement; C0010-P01 deliberately claims only avoidance of Bad_L. XA12 gives a function satisfying its encoded postcondition result=0 but not the intended increment; C0012-P01 is the relative formal-specification claim. In both cases the retained predicate can remain true, yet EXPECTED_A_P_E.NEGATIVE assigns A=true, P=false and E=FAIL. The phrase for the precise violated rule/overclaim does not identify a separate overclaim predicate and leaves the case evaluator capable of falsely failing the retained property. Analogous ambiguity occurs where unauthorized effects, uncalibrated physical time or out-of-fragment seq refute only additional inferences.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

records.title: Control-flow linearity when handlers compose with linear resources

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Control-flow linearity when handlers compose with linear resources

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Algebraic handlers expose continuations; their composition with linear resources reveals an obligation beyond counting occurrences of resource values.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Control-flow linearity, continuation resumption multiplicity, value linearity.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Control-flow linearity, continuation resumption multiplicity, value linearity.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A multi-shot handler duplicates a continuation that writes/closes the same linear file twice; discarding a continuation can violate an exactly-once obligation.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.LOCATOR: §§2.1–2.3 linear file/continuation example; §3.5 Definition 3.5 and Theorem 3.6 (pp54:14–54:15); Appendix A.4; shallow-handler discussion
HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.BOUNDED_SUPPORT: Value linearity alone misses duplicated continuations; control-flow linearity is a distinct composition condition.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.LOCATOR: §4 Theorems 4.3–4.4; §5.1 implementation; benchmark discussion
HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.BOUNDED_SUPPORT: Formal linear-bound core vs broader RaML+ implementation; MLton transformations and LP solver dependencies. Author text inconsistent 20/21 benchmark count; no headline count retained.

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Do not project the modern consolidated property backward as one original discovery. Value linearity alone misses duplicated continuations; control-flow linearity is a distinct composition condition.
GENEALOGY.RELATION_CLASS_EXPLANATION: Mixed documented chronology and analytical mechanism reconstruction; only separately labelled genealogy edges assert direct historical influence.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: When a continuation captures a linear resource, a handler must respect the required continuation-use discipline; value linearity and an effect annotation alone do not compose into resource safety.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.CLAIM_CLASS: Conditional engineering property derived from formal mechanisms and their boundaries
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: A captured continuation, its linear environment and the handler that resumes or discards it.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A multi-shot handler duplicates a continuation that writes/closes the same linear file twice; discarding a continuation can violate an exactly-once obligation.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Track which operations permit nonlinear control flow and constrain continuation resumption relative to captured linear resources.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Add control-flow linearity and prove the combination, or choose a one-shot/region-separation design with an adequate cheaper invariant.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: The combined language can retain linear resource guarantees while supporting effects/handlers under explicit restrictions.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Mechanistic/formal support: Continuation multiplicity and captured resource usage must be related in the handler semantics; value linearity alone leaves the composition gap. No direct comparative engineering-payoff experiment for this whole reconstructed property is established.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: First-class/algebraic effects capture continuations whose environments contain linear/affine obligations.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: A one-shot restriction plus preservation or permitted discharge of captured obligations can be a cheaper satisfying mechanism. Keeping sensitive resources outside captured regions makes this guard false; a pure first-order loop has no handler-composition trigger. One-shot alone does not prove eventual use or prevent an unauthorized discard.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: First-class/algebraic effects capture continuations whose environments contain linear/affine obligations.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Known non-trigger: The guard is demonstrably false because no captured obligation is sensitive to duplication/discard, or no continuation is captured. An adequate one-shot implementation can satisfy an applicable predicate; its existence does not by itself make the guard false. Lower-cost option already recorded: A one-shot restriction plus preservation or permitted discharge of captured obligations can be a cheaper satisfying mechanism. Keeping sensitive resources outside captured regions makes this guard false; a pure first-order loop has no handler-composition trigger. One-shot alone does not prove eventual use or prevent an unauthorized discard. Applicability and evidence limit: A one-shot discipline plus preservation or permitted discharge of captured obligations can satisfy the applicable conservation predicate. A still-owned pending obligation with zero resumptions is not a failure. Keeping sensitive resources outside capture, or using a first-order computation that captures no continuation, is the separate no-trigger path. Preserve the current finite-prefix safety versus eventual-completion distinction.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: The source-defined closed, well-typed, linear-safe initial state; the specified tagging, reduction and handler rules; captured resources and legitimate transfer/discharge remain observable in the model; foreign control escapes are excluded or separately justified. The reduction-safety theorem supplies no standalone termination premise.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: This is a specific higher-order composition condition, not evidence that every effects/ownership combination is safe or every resource must be exactly once.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Continuation multiplicity and captured resource usage must be related in the handler semantics; value linearity alone leaves the composition gap. This is a reduction-safety/conservation guarantee in the stated calculus. It does not establish termination, eventual resumption, eventual physical resource release or production safety of arbitrary runtimes.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Source language definitions/theorems or tool contracts are authoritative only within their versioned scope. This reconstructed research property is not a normative requirement for any target.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Record exact input/model, language/tool version, dependencies, evaluator, observation method and source locators; separate constructed examples, source proofs and observed tool outcomes. Resumption count, captured environment or handler semantics unavailable; foreign call may capture/reinvoke the continuation.

DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS.NOTE: A linear resource type alone misses control flow; a coarse linearity restriction can rule out useful higher-order effect patterns. Relations collection provides directional shared-bearer conditions.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: A multi-shot handler duplicates a continuation that writes/closes the same linear file twice; discarding a continuation can violate an exactly-once obligation. A missing premise produces UNKNOWN for the guarantee, not a fabricated PASS.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: Control-flow linearity when handlers compose with linear resources: When a continuation captures a linear resource, a handler must respect the required continuation-use discipline; value linearity and an effect annotation alone do not compose into resource safety.

VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS.DOMAIN: Source-calculus computations/states linked by one modeled reduction; the initial computation is closed, well typed and linear safe.
Finite multisets of source-defined tagged linear values; L is live-state inventory, S is introduced tagging, T is legitimate tag removal for the reduction. The symbol ⊎ is multiset sum.
VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS.UNIT_OR_SCALE: Model tag multiplicity; not bytes, time or proof of physical resource release.

VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS.DOMAIN: Finite ordered sequence of admitted modeled reductions, including its residual state. An incomplete prefix is not assumed terminal.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For every admitted reduction step, hence every finite prefix from a closed, well-typed, linear-safe initial computation satisfying the source calculus premises. This is safety over prefixes, not an assertion that every run completes or every captured continuation eventually resumes. A terminal state can also retain a legitimate linear result; completion alone is not evidence that every resource has been discharged.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: A modeled reduction/prefix with its residual computation, captured continuation, live tagged resource multiset, newly tagged values and legitimately removed tags; external resource release requires a separate interpretation.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Per-step and finite-prefix safety/conservation. A still-owned pending continuation with zero observed resumptions can satisfy this safety invariant. Its eventual completion remains UNKNOWN without an additional justified liveness premise. Exactly-once use is conditional on the specified completed discharge; no unconditional eventual-resumption theorem is claimed.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: The source-defined closed, well-typed, linear-safe initial state; the specified tagging, reduction and handler rules; captured resources and legitimate transfer/discharge remain observable in the model; foreign control escapes are excluded or separately justified. The reduction-safety theorem supplies no standalone termination premise.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A(k): a captured continuation k contains an obligation affected by duplication or discarding.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: For every admitted modeled reduction from linear-safe M to N, N remains linear-safe and the source-defined tagged-resource accounting satisfies L(M) ⊎ S = L(N) ⊎ T, where L counts currently live tagged linear values, S records values tagged by that step, and T records tags legitimately removed by that step. Read this together with the calculus rules and linear-safety definition: an obligation may remain owned in the residual computation; it is not silently treated as consumed. The corresponding continuation discipline prevents unauthorized duplication/discard of captured linear obligations. Exactly-once resumption/consumption is inferred only for a suitably completed computation with that specific obligation legitimately discharged and no corresponding residual obligation; an eventual claim before completion needs a separate progress/termination argument. Affine disposal is allowed only by its declared weaker policy; multi-shot control requires a compatible duplicable environment.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.NOTE: The conservation equation and linear-safety premise are read from Tang et al. §3.5 Definition 3.5/Theorem 3.6, with Appendix A.4. This intake reconstruction maps them to continuation/resource assessment and explicitly withholds eventual consumption. RaML+ is related cost/handler work, not a substitute liveness theorem.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: The inspected foundations narrative stops after the semantics branch. It gives no substantive branch treatment of type systems or effects/resources/protocols, despite declaring B02–B08 coverage and 24 resolved properties. These records exist in a.json but C13 requires an integrated argument in the human report, not only ledger rows.

The control-flow-linearity predicate turns linear-use safety into an unconditional eventual-resumption claim. It requires each relevant dynamic execution to resume a captured exactly-once continuation exactly once, while its scope explicitly includes admitted transitions/executions and its assumptions do not require completion, termination or discharge of all residual obligations. A safe prefix with a pending continuation therefore violates the literal predicate; a diverging or suspended computation can preserve every linearity invariant without ever resuming that continuation. Checking the combined typing derivation, the stated evaluator, cannot establish this extra liveness claim.

The generic negative-case verdict conflates failure of the retained predicate with failure of a stronger implication. XA10 gives a well-typed, safe function returning zero that violates an intended increment requirement; C0010-P01 deliberately claims only avoidance of Bad_L. XA12 gives a function satisfying its encoded postcondition result=0 but not the intended increment; C0012-P01 is the relative formal-specification claim. In both cases the retained predicate can remain true, yet EXPECTED_A_P_E.NEGATIVE assigns A=true, P=false and E=FAIL. The phrase for the precise violated rule/overclaim does not identify a separate overclaim predicate and leaves the case evaluator capable of falsely failing the retained property. Analogous ambiguity occurs where unauthorized effects, uncalibrated physical time or out-of-fragment seq refute only additional inferences.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Region allocation can reclaim groups of values safely when no semantically live use outlasts the region, but safe lifetime inference does not guarantee optimal retention or universal replacement of garbage collection.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.CLAIM_CLASS: Conditional engineering property derived from formal mechanisms and their boundaries
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: Allocated values, region graph/stack, uses and allocation/deallocation trace.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A reference escapes a deallocated region; an overly large region retains dead objects; safety theorem mistaken for optimal memory consumption.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Infer or annotate region/effect constraints, allocate into regions and deallocate in permitted lifetime order while preserving live-value consistency.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use region polymorphism/precise grouping where valuable and hybrid or managed-memory paths where their costs are lower.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Explicit and sometimes economical reclamation with model-relative lifetime safety.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Region inference implementation is exercised on small author examples, including comparisons of allocation/reclamation strategies. Small historical author experiments; no universal claim that regions minimize memory or outperform garbage collection.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Objects have groups of compatible lifetimes or a consumer needs predictable reclamation units.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Garbage collection is adequate for irregular lifetimes without a strict reclamation constraint; stack allocation suffices for ordinary nonescaping locals.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Objects have groups of compatible lifetimes or a consumer needs predictable reclamation units.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Known non-trigger: No value’s region lifetime is used to justify reclamation; for example, reclamation is justified solely by a separate tracing-GC contract and no region-lifetime claim is made. Lower-cost option already recorded: Garbage collection is adequate for irregular lifetimes without a strict reclamation constraint; stack allocation suffices for ordinary nonescaping locals. Applicability and evidence limit: Stack allocation for nonescaping locals is a small region/lifetime argument when lifetime justifies reclamation, so A remains true. A direct nonescape/live-use argument can satisfy P cheaply. Choosing GC is a no-trigger route only if the region-lifetime justification is actually absent.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Uses and escape paths are covered by region/effect analysis; deallocation discipline matches semantics; foreign references and handlers do not bypass the lifetime boundary.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Regions track lifetime/reclamation, not permission, exactly-once use or minimal peak memory.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Region safety concerns lifetime and escape under the region/effect discipline; bulk reclamation does not imply minimal live space.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Source language definitions/theorems or tool contracts are authoritative only within their versioned scope. This reconstructed research property is not a normative requirement for any target.

DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS.NOTE: Bulk reclamation is coarser than per-cell liveness and may retain memory; combining regions and garbage collection has additional dangling-pointer obligations. Relations collection provides directional shared-bearer conditions.
