PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: Region lifetime discipline for bounded reclamation units: Region allocation can reclaim groups of values safely when no semantically live use outlasts the region, but safe lifetime inference does not guarantee optimal retention or universal replacement of garbage collection.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For every admitted instance/transition explicitly covered by the stated rule and applicability guard; a worked example is not evidence for all programs. Regions track lifetime/reclamation, not permission, exactly-once use or minimal peak memory.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: Allocated values, region graph/stack, uses and allocation/deallocation trace.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Evaluate against the recorded version/environment; execution/transition statements range over the rule's modeled executions, while current evidence is a dated observation. At each deallocate(r) event, no future semantically live use in the modeled execution may dereference a value whose validity requires r. The static region/effect theorem must establish this across covered paths; unreachable stale pointer bits are not automatically live uses.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Uses and escape paths are covered by region/effect analysis; deallocation discipline matches semantics; foreign references and handlers do not bypass the lifetime boundary.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A(v): v is allocated in a region whose lifetime is used to justify reclamation.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE: At each deallocate(r) event, no future semantically live use in the modeled execution may dereference a value whose validity requires r. The static region/effect theorem must establish this across covered paths; unreachable stale pointer bits are not automatically live uses.

SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION.NOTE: This operational rule is a synthesis for intake evaluation, not a formula quoted from a source theorem; source theorems remain bounded by their own language and hypotheses.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Extract allocation/region/effect information from the program and trace model; Check escape constraints and measure peak/retained memory only on named workloads. Map these values into the rule without substituting a successful tool exit for semantic truth.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Uses and escape paths are covered by region/effect analysis; deallocation discipline matches semantics; foreign references and handlers do not bypass the lifetime boundary. Required witness data: region_lifetime_map and escape_and_retention_profile.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Check region/effect derivation and its source-target consistency theorem; test escape cases and measure retention separately.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: The finite instance/trace checks described by the evaluator may be executable. Quantification over all programs, contexts or executions requires the source's restricted theorem/proof; finite testing is incomplete, and timeout yields UNKNOWN.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.POSITIVE_WITNESS: Constructed: all nodes of a temporary parse arena are consumed before the arena is released and none escape to the result.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS: Constructed: a returned closure dereferences a value in an already-released arena; alternatively a safe long-lived region retains many dead nodes, showing safety does not prove economy.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Foreign/reference escape or future live-use evidence absent; memory-efficiency claim lacks workload measurements. Missing evidence is not evidence that the guard is false. If A is already known true, an unestablished model, premise, proof or coverage leaves the operational judgment UNKNOWN through P/E; if a fact needed to decide A itself is unknown, report A=UNKNOWN. Only an established false A permits INAPPLICABLE.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No value’s region lifetime is used to justify reclamation; for example, reclamation is justified solely by a separate tracing-GC contract and no region-lifetime claim is made.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: False positive: treating an incomplete boundary/proxy as the whole claim (A reference escapes a deallocated region; an overly large region retains dead objects; safety theorem mistaken for optimal memory consumption.). False negative: rejecting a valid instance because a conservative analysis or restricted proof language cannot express it; distinguish analyzer rejection from demonstrated semantic failure.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: A checker that rejects everything, empty accepted corpus, erased error nodes, or an observation model that omits the disputed behavior can make apparent success vacuous. Bulk reclamation is coarser than per-cell liveness and may retain memory; combining regions and garbage collection has additional dangling-pointer obligations.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Lifetime/escape, region grouping, foreign references, control flow, allocation policy or runtime representation changes.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Region annotations/inference, memory retained until region end, frequent small region operations and interaction with GC/FFI. Cheaper path: Garbage collection is adequate for irregular lifetimes without a strict reclamation constraint; stack allocation suffices for ordinary nonescaping locals. Applicability and evidence limit: Stack allocation for nonescaping locals is a small region/lifetime argument when lifetime justifies reclamation, so A remains true. A direct nonescape/live-use argument can satisfy P cheaply. Choosing GC is a no-trigger route only if the region-lifetime justification is actually absent.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Tofte–Talpin model-specific safety theorem and small author measurements; no universal memory-efficiency or current compiler adoption claim.

The generic negative-case verdict conflates failure of the retained predicate with failure of a stronger implication. XA10 gives a well-typed, safe function returning zero that violates an intended increment requirement; C0010-P01 deliberately claims only avoidance of Bad_L. XA12 gives a function satisfying its encoded postcondition result=0 but not the intended increment; C0012-P01 is the relative formal-specification claim. In both cases the retained predicate can remain true, yet EXPECTED_A_P_E.NEGATIVE assigns A=true, P=false and E=FAIL. The phrase for the precise violated rule/overclaim does not identify a separate overclaim predicate and leaves the case evaluator capable of falsely failing the retained property. Analogous ambiguity occurs where unauthorized effects, uncalibrated physical time or out-of-fragment seq refute only additional inferences.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.TRANSFERABILITY_LIMITS: Typestate strong updates need alias stability; ordinary object typing does not preserve state facts under interfering aliases.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.UNVERIFIED_OR_OPEN_QUESTIONS: Alias/mutation path not modeled, protocol version or exceptional post-state unspecified. See lane open questions for source-access and implementation gaps.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.NEXT_DISCRIMINATOR: Check protocol pre/post rules and alias permissions; inspect all modeled state-changing/exceptional paths and invalidate facts at uncontrolled boundaries. Supply missing object_protocol / state_fact_permissions evidence before strengthening the verdict.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: The inspected foundations narrative stops after the semantics branch. It gives no substantive branch treatment of type systems or effects/resources/protocols, despite declaring B02–B08 coverage and 24 resolved properties. These records exist in a.json but C13 requires an integrated argument in the human report, not only ledger rows.

The generic negative-case verdict conflates failure of the retained predicate with failure of a stronger implication. XA10 gives a well-typed, safe function returning zero that violates an intended increment requirement; C0010-P01 deliberately claims only avoidance of Bad_L. XA12 gives a function satisfying its encoded postcondition result=0 but not the intended increment; C0012-P01 is the relative formal-specification claim. In both cases the retained predicate can remain true, yet EXPECTED_A_P_E.NEGATIVE assigns A=true, P=false and E=FAIL. The phrase for the precise violated rule/overclaim does not identify a separate overclaim predicate and leaves the case evaluator capable of falsely failing the retained property. Analogous ambiguity occurs where unauthorized effects, uncalibrated physical time or out-of-fragment seq refute only additional inferences.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: No listed finding is not a guarantee of correctness; reviewers and their sampled documentary checks are described in the validation report.

INTAKE.CROSSWALK_ELIGIBILITY_WITH_REASON: Eligible as a conditional candidate with explicit evidence ceiling; rejected/ceremonial records are retained as failure boundaries rather than favorable recommendations.
TARGET_NEUTRAL_AUDIT_QUESTIONS: What exact bearer and version are covered by Typestate transition checking under alias control?
Which observation/evaluator could establish the rule, and which missing premise yields UNKNOWN?
What demonstrates object_protocol and state_fact_permissions rather than a label or empty accepted corpus?
Would the stated cheaper path achieve the actual consumer objective?
PROHIBITED_OVERCLAIMS: Typestate strong updates need alias stability; ordinary object typing does not preserve state facts under interfering aliases.
No claim that a proof, parser, graph, type, capability label or static check establishes natural-language intention without a separate validated bridge.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A transformation or analysis depends on representational invariants that are not guaranteed by parsing alone.

EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.P: WellFormed_IR(r) ∧ ConsumerPreconditions(r); any claim Preserve(lower,r) additionally requires ObsTarget(lower(r)) related to ObsSource(r). WellFormed alone does not imply Preserve.

EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.VERDICT_RULE: Evaluate A (applicability), P (claim truth) and E (evidence adequacy) separately. A=FAIL gives INAPPLICABLE, never a vacuous pass. A=UNKNOWN or required E missing gives UNKNOWN. For A=PASS, sound proof/complete scoped check supports PASS; a valid scoped counterexample gives FAIL; timeout, unsupported features, heuristic failure or incomplete coverage give UNKNOWN. E=FAIL denotes a known mismatch between evidence and bearer, not automatic semantic falsity.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: When a language promises derivation-independent meaning, its elaboration must either choose a specified interpretation or establish coherence for the admitted derivations.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: The same accepted source expression can elaborate through different overload/coercion choices into observably different behavior.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Record resolution rules/evidence and prove the translations equivalent under the chosen observation; reject, annotate or resolve ambiguous cases with a specified policy.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Explicit core languages and checked lowering make choices inspectable; sufficiency conditions must be revised for extensions such as overlapping evidence or effects.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Avoid hidden meaning changes caused by inference order or accidental dictionary selection.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Jones Theorem5 establishes equivalence under unambiguous principal types and evidence equality assumptions; TAL supplies a distinct type-preservation payoff.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: An accepted source admits multiple elaboration/typing derivations and the language claims a unique observable meaning.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Known non-trigger: The accepted source does not admit multiple elaboration/typing derivations, or no unique observable meaning is claimed for those alternatives; for example, a declared nonoverloaded core has exactly one admitted elaboration. Lower-cost option already recorded: An explicitly typed, non-overloaded arithmetic core with one specified elaboration needs no general qualified-type coherence machinery. Applicability and evidence limit: A specified resolution policy may cheaply settle the applicable ambiguity under the rule’s explicit policy alternative. Merely selecting one result does not establish coherence of all previously admitted derivations. A genuine single-elaboration language is the separate no-trigger case.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: The target equality/observation is defined; evidence entailment is coherent; ambiguity restriction and extensions match the proved language.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Conditional semantic/mechanistic result. No universal mandate or legal authority is inferred.

EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.A: An accepted source admits multiple elaboration/typing derivations and the language claims a unique observable meaning.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.P: Elaborate(s,d1)=e1 ∧ Elaborate(s,d2)=e2 ⇒ e1 ≈T e2, subject to the source’s coherence premises. Alternatively an explicit specified resolution selects one derivation without claiming general coherence.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.E: Source term, derivations/resolution traces, environment versions, definition of target equality and theorem premises.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.VERDICT_RULE: Evaluate A (applicability), P (claim truth) and E (evidence adequacy) separately. A=FAIL gives INAPPLICABLE, never a vacuous pass. A=UNKNOWN or required E missing gives UNKNOWN. For A=PASS, sound proof/complete scoped check supports PASS; a valid scoped counterexample gives FAIL; timeout, unsupported features, heuristic failure or incomplete coverage give UNKNOWN. E=FAIL denotes a known mismatch between evidence and bearer, not automatic semantic falsity.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Type inference/coherence checks can be decidable in restricted systems; semantic equivalence of arbitrary targets is not.

If A is already known true, an unestablished model, premise, proof or coverage leaves the operational judgment UNKNOWN through P/E; if a fact needed to decide A itself is unknown, report A=UNKNOWN. PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Check a nonempty intended input/context class and actual successful executions; rejecting every input or observing nothing cannot establish usefulness.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Re-enter on new instances/coercions, imports, evidence equality, defaulting or inference rules; obsolete proofs retain historical scope.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Annotations, evidence tracking and proof obligations grow with extensions; conservative ambiguity checks burden expressiveness. Cheaper path: An explicitly typed, non-overloaded arithmetic core with one specified elaboration needs no general qualified-type coherence machinery. Applicability and evidence limit: A specified resolution policy may cheaply settle the applicable ambiguity under the rule’s explicit policy alternative. Merely selecting one result does not establish coherence of all previously admitted derivations. A genuine single-elaboration language is the separate no-trigger case.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Semantic equivalence for the proved elaboration language and assumptions; no claim of universal inference completeness.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: No listed finding is not a guarantee of correctness; reviewers and their sampled documentary checks are described in the validation report.

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Cousot/Cousot1977 unified dataflow through semantic approximation; later frameworks separated choices of abstraction and convergence. APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A consumer wants absence of a semantic bad behavior over a specified program/input class, or relies on an analysis fact to transform code.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Known non-trigger: Neither absence of semantic bad behavior over a program/input class nor an analysis fact used for a semantic rewrite is claimed; for example, only identifier spelling is checked. Lower-cost option already recorded: To enforce “identifier must match this spelling rule,” a parser/lexical check is adequate; an abstract interpreter adds no semantic benefit. Applicability and evidence limit: An exact finite analysis may cheaply establish the applicable semantic absence claim when its domain and coverage are complete. A lexical spelling check supports only its lexical target; it is no-trigger only when no semantic-absence or rewrite justification is attached.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: Ignoring eval/native code can miss a bad behavior. A sampled loss of zero need not mean global soundness; SAIL uses a separate verifier or manual proof.

EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.A: A consumer wants absence of a semantic bad behavior over a specified program/input class, or relies on an analysis fact to transform code.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.P: I⊆γ(a) ∧ F(γ(a))⊆γ(a) ∧ γ(a)∩Bad=∅ ⇒ Reach(I,F)∩Bad=∅. Sound transfer/fixpoint computation is one way to obtain these premises.

EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.VERDICT_RULE: Evaluate A (applicability), P (claim truth) and E (evidence adequacy) separately. A=FAIL gives INAPPLICABLE, never a vacuous pass. A=UNKNOWN or required E missing gives UNKNOWN. For A=PASS, sound proof/complete scoped check supports PASS; a valid scoped counterexample gives FAIL; timeout, unsupported features, heuristic failure or incomplete coverage give UNKNOWN. E=FAIL denotes a known mismatch between evidence and bearer, not automatic semantic falsity.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Restricted finite models are decidable. General precise reachability is not; widening/overapproximation trades precision for termination.

POSITIVE_WITNESS.WITNESS: Constructed: interval result x∈[0,10] is inductive and excludes x<0, establishing nonnegativity for the modeled loop.

COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS.WITNESS: Constructed: independent x,y intervals lose the invariant x=y and cannot prove x−y=0. A soundiness tool ignoring eval can report no issues while eval executes a bad action. SAIL’s sampled loss alone is not its acceptance proof.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Missing semantics/configuration, unsupported constructs or unavailable proof/check results leave the claim UNKNOWN. Missing evidence is not evidence that the guard is false. If A is already known true, an unestablished model, premise, proof or coverage leaves the operational judgment UNKNOWN through P/E; if a fact needed to decide A itself is unknown, report A=UNKNOWN. Only an established false A permits INAPPLICABLE.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: An incomplete observation map can produce a false assurance; conservative rejection can withhold a true claim. Neither is resolved by a favorable label.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Check a nonempty intended input/context class and actual successful executions; rejecting every input or observing nothing cannot establish usefulness.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Recompute/check when concrete semantics, initial assumptions, libraries, abstractions, transfer functions or widening policy changes; retire unused analysis precision.

A fallback top element remains sound but may be unhelpful. Cheaper path: To enforce “identifier must match this spelling rule,” a parser/lexical check is adequate; an abstract interpreter adds no semantic benefit. Applicability and evidence limit: An exact finite analysis may cheaply establish the applicable semantic absence claim when its domain and coverage are complete. A lexical spelling check supports only its lexical target; it is no-trigger only when no semantic-absence or rewrite justification is attached.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Model-relative safety under checked premises; empirical effectiveness is specialized and benchmark-bound.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: After correctly adding a counterexample to the printed fallback, SB051 still contains the unqualified factual assertion that the implementation has a sound fallback. This exceeds the demonstrated evidence and contradicts the now explicit uncertainty about implementation correspondence.

The normalized access-level enum contradicts the actual inspected portions in several records. SB034, SB039 and SB064 are labeled RELEVANT_SECTIONS_INSPECTED although each explicitly records only abstract/metadata access and failed body retrieval. Conversely SA030 is METADATA_ONLY even though its cited 1994 source theorem/definition sections were inspected; only the separately mentioned 1999 version was metadata-only. The aggregate access counts therefore are not counts of the stated source access. The explanatory normalization note does not repair an inaccurate machine value.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: No listed finding is not a guarantee of correctness; reviewers and their sampled documentary checks are described in the validation report.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Separate sound equality exploration from bounded extraction and optimization benefit

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Tate et al.2009 formulated equality saturation to retain alternatives across transformations; egg2021 makes rebuilding/e-class analyses practical; egglog2023 integrates Datalog; Optimism2026 repairs a cyclic-analysis interaction.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: E-graph; congruence closure; equality saturation; e-class analysis; extraction
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Accumulate equivalences without destructively choosing a rewrite path, then extract a term according to a specified cost.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Greedy pass ordering discards useful alternatives; uncontrolled saturation, unsound rules or a poor cost proxy can still defeat the desired optimization.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.LOCATOR: Reduction order; overlap/critical pairs; completion limitations
Equality-saturation representation and phase-ordering rationale
Theorem 3.1 rebuilding; §4.3 extraction; §5 resource limits and bindings

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Equality saturation can explore many equivalent alternatives, but soundness requires valid equalities and analyses, and extraction quality is relative to represented candidates, cost model and resource limits.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: e-graph, rewrite/analysis system and extracted program
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Greedy pass ordering discards useful alternatives; uncontrolled saturation, unsound rules or a poor cost proxy can still defeat the desired optimization.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Maintain congruence classes, apply guarded equations, rebuild invariants, compute analyses and extract a low-cost representative under explicit limits.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: egglog supports interacting relational analyses; optimistic cyclic analyses require sound handling of well-formed represented graphs and cannot naively interleave tentative facts with irreversible equality merges.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Reduce destructive phase-ordering losses and reuse equivalence information across optimization choices.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Published egg/egglog applications show performance/expressiveness benefits in their cases. Optimism2026 proves a specialized analysis result and evaluates generated programs; none establishes globally fastest code.

Lower-cost option already recorded: For a tiny straight-line expression with one obviously safe local simplification, a terminating greedy rule or unchanged code is adequate. Applicability and evidence limit: One local rule may be adequate for its own transformation objective. If multi-rewrite exploration is actually claimed or performed, a small search space or unchanged extracted result leaves A true. A greedy rule does not establish a broader optimality claim without the corresponding evidence.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Avoiding destructive phase ordering does not abolish exploration-order, budget, representation or cost-model effects; e-class equality is only as sound as its derivation.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.KNOWN_FAILURES_AND_MISUSES: Published Optimism2026 shows naive cyclic optimistic analysis can be unsound. Constructed: add x/x=1 without x≠0, then extract 1 at x=0; or choose fewer AST nodes that execute more slowly on the target.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESPONSE_OR_DESCENDANT_FORM: egglog supports interacting relational analyses; optimistic cyclic analyses require sound handling of well-formed represented graphs and cannot naively interleave tentative facts with irreversible equality merges.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.WHAT_CHANGED_AND_WHAT_DID_NOT: Rebuilding/relational analyses/optimistic repairs expand capability, while semantic premises and finite resource constraints remain.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESIDUAL_LIMITS: No universal cost model or saturation bound; binding/effects/cycles remain representation-specific; current synthetic evaluation is not broad industrial replication.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.CEREMONY_VERSUS_MECHANISM: Counting rewrites, e-nodes or saturation iterations can reward search growth without valid or useful output.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RETENTION_RATIONALE: Retain non-destructive exploration as a guarded mechanism; reject unconditional optimality and “rebuilding terminates therefore saturation terminates.”

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Instantiate compiler preservation at the exact semantic endpoints and premises

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: CompCert’s 2009 verified Cminor back end developed simulation proofs for a restricted pipeline. Current 3.18 composes a larger C-AST pipeline and includes a modeled separate-compilation theorem; trusted-boundary scrutiny evolves alongside it.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Backward simulation; behavior improvement; refinement; semantic preservation; successful compilation
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Prove once that every successful application of a compiler function preserves an explicitly modeled relation.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Compiler bugs introduce behaviors absent from a safe source; a true AST-level theorem is advertised as source-text-to-deployed-system correctness.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.LOCATOR: §2.1 semantic preservation; §2.2 verified validators and certifying compilation

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Do not project current features, proof coverage or terminology backwards onto earlier versions.
GENEALOGY.RELATION_CLASS_EXPLANATION: Detailed dated historical/analytical edges are in genealogy_edges; this record summarizes qualified present evolution and does not claim every cited source influenced every other source.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: A compiler preservation theorem justifies only its stated source/target semantic relation for matching versions/configurations and satisfied premises; successful compilation and external intent are separate questions.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: CompCert source AST, generated assembly AST and preservation theorem
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Compiler bugs introduce behaviors absent from a safe source; a true AST-level theorem is advertised as source-text-to-deployed-system correctness.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Prove simulation for passes, compose them, derive behavior refinement under safety assumptions, and inventory every conversion between the theorem’s formal endpoints and the actual build/run.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Current CompCert adds source passes and formal separate linking; verified validation can be embedded in the pipeline; TCB studies identify semantic/output obligations beyond internal pass proofs.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Exclude modeled miscompilations across all successful inputs rather than only sampled tests.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Current formal theorem statements support the modeled guarantee. TCB case analysis and root Csmith EPLT-SR002 provide boundary/failure evidence; no lane-wide quantitative defect-rate comparison is claimed.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: A user transferring a proved source property through a specific compiler invocation.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Per-run translation validation; restricted interpreter; differential testing where universal proof is unnecessary.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A source-level claim is being transferred to an artifact produced by a compiler whose preservation theorem is invoked.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Known non-trigger: No source claim is transferred to an artifact by invoking a compiler-preservation theorem; for example, the question concerns parsing only and makes no execution-correspondence claim. Lower-cost option already recorded: If the question only asks whether a file parses, a parser result is sufficient; importing a compiler-preservation theorem answers a different question. Applicability and evidence limit: An existing matching theorem can cheaply establish the applicable transfer once its fragment, configuration and environment premises are discharged. Not having inspected such a theorem while claiming that transfer yields UNKNOWN, not a false guard.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Compiler function returns OK; source and target ASTs/configurations match the theorem; source safety needed for plain refinement; external calls and machine model follow the specified environment.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: CompCert 3.18 Csyntax AST to Asm AST. Modeled link_list theorem covers matching compiled unit lists; preprocessing/elaboration, assembly output and external tool/runtime realization require separate correspondence.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Specified observable behavior and successful supported compilation. Excludes: Source requirement correctness, all C extensions/concurrency, timing/memory bounds, arbitrary hostile contexts, and universal source-text-to-physical-system proof.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Conditional semantic/mechanistic result. No universal mandate or legal authority is inferred.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Theorem/version identity, exact input/output/configuration, proof dependencies, successful result and evidence for source safety/FFI/model assumptions.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS: EPLT-C0102 addresses source elaboration; EPLT-C0104 pass semantics; EPLT-C0108 validated passes; EPLT-C0110 linking/foreign assumptions; EPLT-C0116 runtime realization; EPLT-C0114 and EPLT-C0115 version currency.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: Model or output-printer discrepancy can invalidate a deployment claim while the pass theorem remains true. Source UB weakens the conclusion; an always-reject compiler is vacuously safe but unusable.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Formal semantics and per-pass proofs impose maintenance; supported features/configurations and compilation failures constrain use.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Recheck exact compiler release, proof artifact, flags, front end, assembler/linker, source features and external specification after change; do not transfer a theorem solely by product name.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: A compiler preservation theorem justifies only its stated source/target semantic relation for matching versions/configurations and satisfied premises; successful compilation and external intent are separate questions.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: p:Csyntax.program; tp:Asm.program; behaviors include termination, divergence, observable events and wrong behavior as defined by CompCert.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For every p,tp with C(p)=OK(tp); refinement corollary additionally quantifies over all source behaviors being not_wrong.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: CompCert source AST, generated assembly AST and preservation theorem
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Whole execution behavior unless the explicit relation below restricts the observation to states or finite traces.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Compiler function returns OK; source and target ASTs/configurations match the theorem; source safety needed for plain refinement; external calls and machine model follow the specified environment.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A source-level claim is being transferred to an artifact produced by a compiler whose preservation theorem is invoked.

EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.A: A source-level claim is being transferred to an artifact produced by a compiler whose preservation theorem is invoked.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.P: C(p)=OK(tp) ⇒ backward_simulation(SemS(p),SemT(tp)). If all source behaviors are not_wrong, every target behavior is a source behavior. Separate linking requires pairwise compiled nonempty unit lists and successful source link.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.E: Theorem/version identity, exact input/output/configuration, proof dependencies, successful result and evidence for source safety/FFI/model assumptions.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.VERDICT_RULE: Evaluate A (applicability), P (claim truth) and E (evidence adequacy) separately. A=FAIL gives INAPPLICABLE, never a vacuous pass. A=UNKNOWN or required E missing gives UNKNOWN. For A=PASS, sound proof/complete scoped check supports PASS; a valid scoped counterexample gives FAIL; timeout, unsupported features, heuristic failure or incomplete coverage give UNKNOWN. E=FAIL denotes a known mismatch between evidence and bearer, not automatic semantic falsity.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION: Source-defined CompCert 3.18 Compiler/Complements theorem statements, paraphrased without changing endpoints or safety guard.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Termination/divergence and declared externally visible events. Execution time, arbitrary memory consumption and unmodeled side channels are not automatically observations.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Theorem/version identity, exact input/output/configuration, proof dependencies, successful result and evidence for source safety/FFI/model assumptions.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Match endpoint artifacts and premises, inspect proof dependencies, then compose with separately justified text/binary/runtime correspondences if deployment is claimed.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: The theorem is machine-checkable in its proof system; arbitrary source safety and environmental correspondence remain undecidable/general obligations.

POSITIVE_WITNESS.WITNESS: Source-grounded: a successfully compiled safe C AST instantiated in 3.18 falls under the behavior-refinement corollary; modeled separate linking uses its additional premises.

COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS.WITNESS: Constructed: source returns0 but requirement was return1; correct compiler preserves the mistake. Published TCB cases show assembly/model errors outside verified passes. An error return does not demonstrate a false preservation theorem.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Missing semantics/configuration, unsupported constructs or unavailable proof/check results leave the claim UNKNOWN. Missing evidence is not evidence that the guard is false. If A is already known true, an unestablished model, premise, proof or coverage leaves the operational judgment UNKNOWN through P/E; if a fact needed to decide A itself is unknown, report A=UNKNOWN. Only an established false A permits INAPPLICABLE.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No source claim is transferred to an artifact by invoking a compiler-preservation theorem; for example, the question concerns parsing only and makes no execution-correspondence claim.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: An incomplete observation map can produce a false assurance; conservative rejection can withhold a true claim. Neither is resolved by a favorable label.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Check a nonempty intended input/context class and actual successful executions; rejecting every input or observing nothing cannot establish usefulness.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Recheck exact compiler release, proof artifact, flags, front end, assembler/linker, source features and external specification after change; do not transfer a theorem solely by product name.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Formal semantics and per-pass proofs impose maintenance; supported features/configurations and compilation failures constrain use. Cheaper path: If the question only asks whether a file parses, a parser result is sufficient; importing a compiler-preservation theorem answers a different question. RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: Two integrated reverse-edge explanations do not describe the reverse of the recorded relation. RM11 goes ordinary compiler correspondence→secure compilation, but its reverse explanation again says ordinary correctness alone does not establish security (the forward insufficiency). RM18 defines a shared finite-testing clause and evidence dependence, which is symmetric on that clause, yet marks every automatic reverse unsupported and explains only why the extra reproducibility clause is not implied by the narrower record. This conflates symmetric partial evidence overlap with directional whole-record implication.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: No listed finding is not a guarantee of correctness; reviewers and their sampled documentary checks are described in the validation report.

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: CakeML2014 combined language implementation and in-logic bootstrapping. The 2019 backend integrates multiple IRs, binary encoders, GC and bignums; Silver2019 composes the chain with a processor model.

GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: An AST/assembly proof leaves object encoding, runtime allocation/GC and bootstrapping as unconnected parts; stronger endpoint claims can still ignore installation/FFI/resource premises.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: The assurance claim crosses from language source into encoded machine code and runtime behavior.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Known non-trigger: The assurance claim is confined to an abstract source/model result and does not cross into encoded machine code and runtime behavior; for example, only a mathematical evaluator is discussed with no concrete-execution assurance. Lower-cost option already recorded: For a tiny bounded expression language, a small interpreter with explicit integer/environment semantics can be sufficient without self-hosting or multiple verified backends. Applicability and evidence limit: A small interpreter reduces the implementation boundary but does not remove it when actual execution is claimed. Adequate evidence must establish the exact declared source-to-execution relation, including its applicable configuration/installation/external-call/resource premises. A different interpreter theorem is a separately identified relation, not automatic PASS for the specific CakeML compilation formula.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Validate each translation under a sound checker and preserve inconclusive outcomes

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Pnueli/Siegel/Singerman1998 introduced translation validation; Necula2000 implemented per-pass checks for GCC. Leroy formalized verified-validator architecture; Alive2 and MLIR tools instantiate richer IR semantics with bounded practical checking.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Translation validation; validator soundness; simulation invariant; bounded refinement
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Check source/target correspondence for each compiler result instead of trusting or proving the optimizer that produced it.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A changing or heuristic optimizer is difficult to verify wholesale; a validator’s timeout, incomplete inference or bounded search is mistaken for a universal pass.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.LOCATOR: Founding translation-validation formulation
Simulation relation; invariant inference; §5 results/limitations
§2.1 semantic preservation; §2.2 verified validators and certifying compilation

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Do not project current features, proof coverage or terminology backwards onto earlier versions.
GENEALOGY.RELATION_CLASS_EXPLANATION: Detailed dated historical/analytical edges are in genealogy_edges; this record summarizes qualified present evolution and does not claim every cited source influenced every other source.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: A sound validator can justify the particular accepted source/target pair independently of translator correctness, but only for its modeled fragment and bounds; nonacceptance need not be a bug witness.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: source/target translation pair, validator and modeled execution scope
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A changing or heuristic optimizer is difficult to verify wholesale; a validator’s timeout, incomplete inference or bounded search is mistaken for a universal pass.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Construct a relational verification condition or simulation invariant for the pair and check it using trusted/proved validation logic; separate SAT counterexample, UNSAT result, timeout and unsupported input.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: SMT-based definedness/memory-aware validators and semantic dialect tooling extend applicability; verified validators can be embedded within verified compilers.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Permit aggressive/untrusted search while localizing semantic assurance in a checker.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Necula’s prototype and Alive2/MLIR campaigns report discovered transformation bugs. A checker-soundness theorem gives conditional pairwise assurance; campaign results do not prove the entire translator.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Once-proved translator; proof-carrying result; restricted identity/pass; finite testing with narrower confidence.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A concrete source/target pair is available and its preservation claim must be checked under a specified model.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Known non-trigger: No concrete source/target pair is the subject of a preservation check under a specified model; for example, the task records one artifact’s identity without a source-to-target preservation claim. Lower-cost option already recorded: If a transformation is identity and byte/AST identity is the entire required relation, direct equality may suffice; general relational solving is unnecessary. Applicability and evidence limit: For an identity translation, direct byte/AST equality can establish P cheaply if equality is the entire required relation under the same interpretation and configuration. A remains true for that preservation check. Equal syntax under differing semantics, incomplete feature coverage or missing interpretation is insufficient; use UNKNOWN when the required premises are unavailable.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Validator encoding and solver/checker are sound; all relevant semantics/features supported; bounds cover the quantified executions or conclusion explicitly remains bounded.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: One validated pair/pass and its semantics; parser, downstream code generation and runtime may lie outside it.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Accepted pair’s declared relation, with loop/resource bounds explicit. Excludes: Validator completeness, all-pass/all-program compiler correctness from sampled accepted pairs, or source requirement correctness.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Conditional semantic/mechanistic result. No universal mandate or legal authority is inferred.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Both artifacts, versioned semantics, validator soundness basis, solver outcome and bounds/unsupported-feature checks.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS: EPLT-C0104 supplies relation/premises; EPLT-C0106 may trust a verified validator; EPLT-C0115 includes validator/model versions; EPLT-C0117 prevents finite-validation corpus inflation.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: Missing LLVM features or unrolling bounds can hide a counterexample; faulty memory/poison encoding can accept a bad pair; inference failure can reject a correct pair.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Per-translation solver cost and timeouts; model updates track IR evolution; failing closed can block compilation.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Revalidate when either artifact, IR semantics, validator, solver assumptions, flags or bounds change; do not reuse acceptance keyed only to source text.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A concrete source/target pair is available and its preservation claim must be checked under a specified model.

EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.A: A concrete source/target pair is available and its preservation claim must be checked under a specified model.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.P: Sound(V,M,B) ∧ V(s,t)=ACCEPT ⇒ Rel_M,B(s,t). If B is a proper subset of executions, do not infer Rel_M,all(s,t). A concrete counterexample falsifies the applicable relation; timeout does not.

EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.VERDICT_RULE: Evaluate A (applicability), P (claim truth) and E (evidence adequacy) separately. A=FAIL gives INAPPLICABLE, never a vacuous pass. A=UNKNOWN or required E missing gives UNKNOWN. For A=PASS, sound proof/complete scoped check supports PASS; a valid scoped counterexample gives FAIL; timeout, unsupported features, heuristic failure or incomplete coverage give UNKNOWN. E=FAIL denotes a known mismatch between evidence and bearer, not automatic semantic falsity.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION: Researcher operational form of verified-validator soundness from Leroy2009, with Alive2’s bounded scope explicitly added.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Missing semantics/configuration, unsupported constructs or unavailable proof/check results leave the claim UNKNOWN. Missing evidence is not evidence that the guard is false. If A is already known true, an unestablished model, premise, proof or coverage leaves the operational judgment UNKNOWN through P/E; if a fact needed to decide A itself is unknown, report A=UNKNOWN. Only an established false A permits INAPPLICABLE.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: Several citation-ready entries print the mature modern claim but retain only the first three historical source links. Those displayed paths do not directly establish important parts of the printed claim, and one uses metadata-only Huet as though it supported a current transformation mechanism.

The normalized access-level enum contradicts the actual inspected portions in several records. SB034, SB039 and SB064 are labeled RELEVANT_SECTIONS_INSPECTED although each explicitly records only abstract/metadata access and failed body retrieval. Conversely SA030 is METADATA_ONLY even though its cited 1994 source theorem/definition sections were inspected; only the separately mentioned 1999 version was metadata-only. The aggregate access counts therefore are not counts of the stated source access. The explanatory normalization note does not repair an inaccurate machine value.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: No listed finding is not a guarantee of correctness; reviewers and their sampled documentary checks are described in the validation report.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Check proof-carrying results against the consumer’s explicit policy

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Necula1997 attached safety proofs to native code; typed assembly offered related checkable low-level evidence. Leroy distinguishes compiler verification, result validation and certifying/PCC architectures.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Proof-carrying code; safety policy; verification condition; certifying compiler; proof checker
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: An untrusted producer supplies code and a proof that a small consumer-side checker can verify against a chosen safety policy.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A consumer must accept foreign code without trusting its producer; a valid proof for a weak policy can be mistaken for every desired property.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.LOCATOR: Theorem 3.1 VC soundness; safety-policy signature; proof checking
§7.3 type safety; typed CPS and closure conversion

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Do not project current features, proof coverage or terminology backwards onto earlier versions.
GENEALOGY.RELATION_CLASS_EXPLANATION: Detailed dated historical/analytical edges are in genealogy_edges; this record summarizes qualified present evolution and does not claim every cited source influenced every other source.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: A proof-carrying artifact establishes only the checked proposition/policy for the exact code and initial/environment assumptions; safety certificates do not automatically establish source-target equivalence.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: target code, consumer policy, proof certificate and checker
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A consumer must accept foreign code without trusting its producer; a valid proof for a weak policy can be mistaken for every desired property.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Generate a VC from code and policy, check a proof with explicit axioms and bind it to the code; the producer’s search/certifier can be untrusted if acceptance checking is sound.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Typed low-level evidence and verified validators are alternative certificate forms; richer policies widen assurance only when their semantics and checker obligations are supplied.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Move trust from a complex producer toward a smaller checkable interface and enable safe acceptance of untrusted code.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: PCC Theorem3.1 gives modeled memory-read safety and a conditional postcondition; TAL safety and compiler-architecture analysis establish related but different guarantees.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: The code consumer defining an admissible safety policy.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Sandbox/runtime checking; typed bytecode verifier; translation validation; direct review for a small trusted routine.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Code from an untrusted/complex producer is accepted on the basis of a proof or typed certificate.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Known non-trigger: Code from an untrusted or complex producer is not accepted on the basis of a proof or typed certificate; for example, a local constant is evaluated directly with no certificate-based acceptance claim. Lower-cost option already recorded: A fixed local constant expression with no foreign access needs no portable safety certificate; direct evaluation/review can suffice. Applicability and evidence limit: A small proof or direct certificate checker can cheaply establish the applicable policy claim. Direct evaluation without certificate-based acceptance is a different assurance target. The code being a constant or having no foreign access does not negate A if its acceptance still relies on a certificate.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Policy captures desired forbidden actions; VC generator and checker are sound; proof/axioms match exact code; execution satisfies initial and machine/environment premises.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Target-code policy theorem. Source meaning enters only if the certificate explicitly proves a correspondence relation.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Encoded safety/postcondition under stated machine model. Excludes: Automatic confidentiality, termination, source fidelity, useful behavior or trusted distribution from a generic proof badge.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Conditional semantic/mechanistic result. No universal mandate or legal authority is inferred.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Exact code/VC/proof identities, checked theorem, policy semantics, checker/axioms and initial-state evidence.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS: EPLT-C0106 and EPLT-C0108 distinguish compiler/pairwise claims; EPLT-C0111 adds adversarial context/security policies; EPLT-C0116 realizes machine model; EPLT-C0115 binds certificate to current code.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: A memory-safe program may intentionally disclose a secret through allowed I/O; a proof attached to altered bytes proves the wrong object.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Proof generation/size, policy specification, VC/checker trust and certificate/code binding maintenance.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Recheck on code, policy, checker, axioms, initial state or machine/environment change; retire certificates for unsupported policy versions.

EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.VERDICT_RULE: Evaluate A (applicability), P (claim truth) and E (evidence adequacy) separately. A=FAIL gives INAPPLICABLE, never a vacuous pass. A=UNKNOWN or required E missing gives UNKNOWN. For A=PASS, sound proof/complete scoped check supports PASS; a valid scoped counterexample gives FAIL; timeout, unsupported features, heuristic failure or incomplete coverage give UNKNOWN. E=FAIL denotes a known mismatch between evidence and bearer, not automatic semantic falsity.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Compose component claims only within the proved context and linking relation
PROPERTY_FAMILIES: B13 Modularity, linking and foreign interfaces

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Existential abstraction explains representation hiding; ML modules distinguish abstract and manifest types needed for separate checking. Multi-language semantics and Melocoton make language-boundary obligations explicit. CompCert supplies a separate-compilation theorem for its modeled unit/link relation.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Existential package; abstract/manifest type; signature; functor; contextual equivalence; linking; FFI wrapper
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Hide representation behind an interface and allow clients to depend only on the interface’s justified operations and laws.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Local type correctness and an unchanged exported signature do not ensure compatible ownership, layout, calling convention, exceptions, atomic mappings or behavior after linking.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.LOCATOR: Introduction: information hiding versus behavioral specification
Abstract versus manifest type equations; compilation-unit/module distinction
Institutional abstract: boundary composition and abstraction of low-level details

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Do not project current features, proof coverage or terminology backwards onto earlier versions.
GENEALOGY.RELATION_CLASS_EXPLANATION: Detailed dated historical/analytical edges are in genealogy_edges; this record summarizes qualified present evolution and does not claim every cited source influenced every other source.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Substitution and separate compilation preserve a component claim only for the stated class of contexts, interface laws, linking semantics and foreign-runtime assumptions; textual interface identity alone is insufficient.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: component pair, its interface and the set of linkable source/target contexts
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Local type correctness and an unchanged exported signature do not ensure compatible ownership, layout, calling convention, exceptions, atomic mappings or behavior after linking.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Relate implementations at an abstract interface, quantify over permitted contexts, and discharge link/FFI invariants. Type equalities, rooting, ownership and memory/exception conventions are explicit premises, not implied by a file/module name.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Manifest-type modules support separate checking; contextual/logical relations and mixed-language separation logic express behavioral obligations. CompCert modeled linking and Melocoton wrapper adequacy give different, precise composition results.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Local reasoning can survive replacement and mixed-language assembly without re-proving every client, when the contract covers the boundary behavior.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: CompCert’s separate_transf_c_program_correct quantifies over pairwise-compiled units and a successful source link. Melocoton Theorems4.1/4.2 compose language-local reasoning and give mixed-program safety/conditional postconditions. MixTesting provides a concrete failure of an omitted atomic-ABI obligation.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: A linker, component integrator or client relying on a replacement module/plugin/foreign library.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Whole-program verification; a single-language implementation; copying/serialization boundary; runtime wrapper checks; rebuilding all components under one compatible configuration.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A correctness claim crosses a component, version, language, dynamically loaded plugin or separately compiled unit boundary.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Known non-trigger: No correctness claim crosses any component, version, language, dynamically loaded plugin or separately compiled-unit boundary; for example, a closed whole-program claim has no such cross-boundary inference. Lower-cost option already recorded: A closed sequential program with no separately replaceable or foreign component needs no general hostile-context theorem; direct whole-program checking can be adequate. Applicability and evidence limit: A small interface, restricted context class or complete whole-program argument can cheaply discharge an applicable composition claim if it covers the exact declared relation. A closed sequential program can still contain component/version boundaries; lack of hostile contexts does not itself negate this guard.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Context obeys the declared interface laws and ownership; link succeeds under the modeled rules; ABI/layout/exception/rooting/atomic conventions agree; any foreign implementation realizes the wrapper semantics.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Source module/type abstraction, modeled source/assembly linking, and explicit mixed OCaml-like/C-like language wrappers. Dynamic loading is covered only by a model that includes its new contexts and lifetime changes.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: The proved context class and exact link/wrapper semantics, with resulting safety or observable equivalence stated separately. Excludes: Arbitrary native libraries, unmodeled loader/symbol interposition, actual OCaml-runtime conformance, exceptions and multithreading omitted by Melocoton, and all algebraic interface laws from types alone.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Conditional semantic/mechanistic result. No universal mandate or legal authority is inferred.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Exact interface and behavioral laws, context class, successful modeled link, representation/FFI proof, ABI/configuration identities and correspondence to the actual loader/runtime.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS: EPLT-C0106 supplies modeled separate compilation; EPLT-C0111 enlarges the context class adversarially; EPLT-C0112 supplies memory/atomic compatibility; EPLT-C0114–EPLT-C0115 govern version/context change; EPLT-C0116 supplies runtime realization.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: An unchanged signature can conceal a changed representation/ownership contract. A C callback may keep an unregistered managed pointer across moving GC. Individually correct atomic compiler mappings may be incompatible when mixed.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Behavioral contract specification, relation proofs, ABI matrices and wrapper/root maintenance; whole-program restrictions can reduce this cost.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Recheck on interface laws, implementation representation, loader policy, ABI, GC/root API, memory model, exception semantics, compiler configuration or foreign dependency change.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For every context admitted by I for which the modeled links are defined; not every executable context on the platform.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: component pair, its interface and the set of linkable source/target contexts
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Whole execution behavior unless the explicit relation below restricts the observation to states or finite traces.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Context obeys the declared interface laws and ownership; link succeeds under the modeled rules; ABI/layout/exception/rooting/atomic conventions agree; any foreign implementation realizes the wrapper semantics.

EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.A: A correctness claim crosses a component, version, language, dynamically loaded plugin or separately compiled unit boundary.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.P: M1 ≈I M2 ⇒ ∀C∈Contexts(I). Obs(Link(C,M1)) = Obs(Link(C,M2)), with ≈I and Link obligations proved in the same model. A safety-only relation substitutes Safety for equality and does not become equivalence.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.E: Exact interface and behavioral laws, context class, successful modeled link, representation/FFI proof, ABI/configuration identities and correspondence to the actual loader/runtime.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.VERDICT_RULE: Evaluate A (applicability), P (claim truth) and E (evidence adequacy) separately. A=FAIL gives INAPPLICABLE, never a vacuous pass. A=UNKNOWN or required E missing gives UNKNOWN. For A=PASS, sound proof/complete scoped check supports PASS; a valid scoped counterexample gives FAIL; timeout, unsupported features, heuristic failure or incomplete coverage give UNKNOWN. E=FAIL denotes a known mismatch between evidence and bearer, not automatic semantic falsity.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION: Researcher operational reconstruction of the cited semantic relation; source theorem limits remain explicit.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Inspect context and linking premises; check wrapper invariants; seek a client that distinguishes replacements or an execution that violates an omitted boundary convention.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: General contextual equivalence is undecidable; type/interface checks and particular relational proofs are partial sufficient methods.

POSITIVE_WITNESS.WITNESS: Source-grounded: Melocoton composes verified language-local components through its root/representation wrapper and proves mixed-program safety, allowing divergence and constraining terminating integers.

COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS.WITNESS: Published: MixTesting Example1.1 combines individually correct Armv7-style loads and Armv8-style stores, admitting the both-zero store-buffering result forbidden by the source SC atomics. Constructed FFI variant: an unregistered C pointer becomes stale after a moving collection.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Missing semantics/configuration, unsupported constructs or unavailable proof/check results leave the claim UNKNOWN. Missing evidence is not evidence that the guard is false. If A is already known true, an unestablished model, premise, proof or coverage leaves the operational judgment UNKNOWN through P/E; if a fact needed to decide A itself is unknown, report A=UNKNOWN. Only an established false A permits INAPPLICABLE.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No correctness claim crosses any component, version, language, dynamically loaded plugin or separately compiled-unit boundary; for example, a closed whole-program claim has no such cross-boundary inference.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: An incomplete observation map can produce a false assurance; conservative rejection can withhold a true claim. Neither is resolved by a favorable label.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Check a nonempty intended input/context class and actual successful executions; rejecting every input or observing nothing cannot establish usefulness.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Recheck on interface laws, implementation representation, loader policy, ABI, GC/root API, memory model, exception semantics, compiler configuration or foreign dependency change.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Behavioral contract specification, relation proofs, ABI matrices and wrapper/root maintenance; whole-program restrictions can reduce this cost. Cheaper path: A closed sequential program with no separately replaceable or foreign component needs no general hostile-context theorem; direct whole-program checking can be adequate. Applicability and evidence limit: A small interface, restricted context class or complete whole-program argument can cheaply discharge an applicable composition claim if it covers the exact declared relation. A closed sequential program can still contain component/version boundaries; lack of hostile contexts does not itself negate this guard.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: The normalized access-level enum contradicts the actual inspected portions in several records. SB034, SB039 and SB064 are labeled RELEVANT_SECTIONS_INSPECTED although each explicitly records only abstract/metadata access and failed body retrieval. Conversely SA030 is METADATA_ONLY even though its cited 1994 source theorem/definition sections were inspected; only the separately mentioned 1999 version was metadata-only. The aggregate access counts therefore are not counts of the stated source access. The explanatory normalization note does not repair an inaccurate machine value.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.
