records.title: Preserve explicitly chosen security properties against the modeled adversarial contexts

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Preserve explicitly chosen security properties against the modeled adversarial contexts

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Full-abstraction work asks whether source contextual distinctions survive translation. The robust-preservation hierarchy distinguishes trace properties from hyperproperties and relational criteria. SECOMP applies robust safety to compartmentalized C; later noninterference compilation and RobustDimSum address leakage and linking boundaries through different models.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Full abstraction; robust trace/safety preservation; hyperproperty; back-translation; dynamic compromise; noninterference
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Prevent a target-language context from gaining distinctions or causing forbidden behavior unavailable to a source-language attacker.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: Ordinary functional correspondence can omit hostile contexts or attacker-visible timing/address traces; therefore it need not preserve confidentiality or component isolation.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.LOCATOR: Robust trace properties, hyperproperties and context quantification

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Do not project current features, proof coverage or terminology backwards onto earlier versions.
GENEALOGY.RELATION_CLASS_EXPLANATION: Detailed dated historical/analytical edges are in genealogy_edges; this record summarizes qualified present evolution and does not claim every cited source influenced every other source.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Secure compilation requires a property class, attacker contexts and observations matched to the intended threat. Trace preservation, full abstraction and hyperproperty preservation are distinct criteria with different quantifier strength.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: source component, compiled component, attacker context class and security observation model
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: Ordinary functional correspondence can omit hostile contexts or attacker-visible timing/address traces; therefore it need not preserve confidentiality or component isolation.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Prove every relevant target attack/observation has a permitted source explanation (back-translation), or use suitable simulation/logical-relational arguments; enforce target protection and account for compromise/leakage explicitly.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Robust property hierarchies distinguish trace-level and whole-behavior-set criteria. SECOMP adds compartment-aware traces and dynamic compromise; leakage-sensitive simulations preserve noninterference; RobustDimSum composes robust-safety results via semantic back-translation into a capability target.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: A verified source security invariant can survive linking with modeled untrusted target components.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Formal conditional criteria and model-specific proofs exist. SECOMP extended paper states Theorem8.1 for bounded prefixes and an axiomatized/tested backtranslation-success assumption; the current artifact remains unintegrated with noted admits. RobustDimSum’s 2026 model theorem does not certify a physical CHERI toolchain.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: A component owner relying on isolation, noninterference or robust safety after compilation and linking with untrusted code.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Single-language trusted contexts; OS/process isolation; explicit sandbox/capability wrapper; a narrower safety property if it captures the actual risk.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A required property must hold after an adversarial or more expressive target context interacts with compiled components.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Known non-trigger: No required property is asserted against an adversarial or more expressive target context interacting with compiled components; for example, only closed ordinary functional behavior in the stated trusted context is claimed. Lower-cost option already recorded: If every linked component is trusted and the claim is ordinary functional behavior, ordinary contextual/whole-program correspondence can be adequate; a full hostile-context theorem adds no automatic value. Applicability and evidence limit: Restricting the actual context/threat model can reduce the needed proof. A trusted context can still be more expressive than the source; if either triggering context condition remains, A is true and the chosen robust property needs its exact evidence. Ordinary functional correspondence alone does not prove a surviving security claim.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Exact attacker authority, allowed interfaces, observation/leakage model, target protection mechanisms and source well-formedness; every proof axiom, trace bound and compromise rule is part of the claim.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: SECOMP: compartment-aware Clight-to-extended-RISC-V block-memory security model, scalar cross-compartment values and bounded trace prefixes. Noninterference and RobustDimSum use their own modeled languages and leakage/capability assumptions.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Chosen robust property class within admitted source/target contexts and observations. Excludes: All side channels, physical target enforcement, arbitrary shared pointers, universal confidentiality from robust trace safety, and a fully integrated current SECOMP proof without admits.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Conditional semantic/mechanistic result. No universal mandate or legal authority is inferred.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Chosen security criterion, explicit attacker/observation models, proved theorem with axioms and bounds, versioned artifact status, and actual target enforcement correspondence.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: Two integrated reverse-edge explanations do not describe the reverse of the recorded relation. RM11 goes ordinary compiler correspondence→secure compilation, but its reverse explanation again says ordinary correctness alone does not establish security (the forward insufficiency). RM18 defines a shared finite-testing clause and evidence dependence, which is symmetric on that clause, yet marks every automatic reverse unsupported and explains only why the extra reproducibility clause is not implied by the narrower record. This conflates symmetric partial evidence overlap with directional whole-record implication.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Evaluate concurrent transformations in the stated event and memory model
PROPERTY_FAMILIES: B14 Concurrent execution and weak memory

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: CSP’s synchronous communicating processes, actor-style asynchronous messages and event structures retain different interaction information. Lamport specifies processor-memory SC; Herlihy/Wing define object-history linearizability. C/C++ weak-memory formalizations, Promising and IMM address compiler mapping legality; MixTesting exposes mixed-mapping composition.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Trace; interleaving; partial order; causality; happens-before; reads-from; coherence; linearization; promise certification
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Give concurrent executions a precise admissibility relation rather than infer outcomes from source textual order.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A sequentially valid reorder or independently correct mapping can admit forbidden concurrent observations under interference, weak memory or incompatible separately compiled units.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.LOCATOR: Guarded commands; synchronous I/O; §7.2 libraries; §7.4 buffering
Sequential consistency definition; counterexample and requirements R1/R2
Act3; asynchronous messages; dynamic state and reconfiguration
§2 history semantics; legal sequential history; real-time order and locality
Interleavings; causal independence; event structure configurations; relation to domains

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Do not project current features, proof coverage or terminology backwards onto earlier versions.
GENEALOGY.RELATION_CLASS_EXPLANATION: Detailed dated historical/analytical edges are in genealogy_edges; this record summarizes qualified present evolution and does not claim every cited source influenced every other source.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Transformation correctness is relative to specified memory/event semantics and observables. SC, linearizability, causal partial orders and message-passing traces are different relations; their guarantees cannot be exchanged by name.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: concurrent program or object history and its source/target event models
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A sequentially valid reorder or independently correct mapping can admit forbidden concurrent observations under interference, weak memory or incompatible separately compiled units.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Define valid execution graphs/histories, preserve the required source-to-target outcome relation and prove mapping compatibility. Distinguish operation invocation/response order from individual memory events and hidden propagation steps.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Promising uses certifiable thread-local promises; IMM provides a mechanized intermediate weak-memory model and corrected mapping results. Atomic-ABI analysis addresses mixing. A 2021 correction repairs the pending-invocation condition in the original linearizability definition.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Expose source-forbidden outcomes and justify optimizations/mappings without assuming all concurrent executions are simple source-order interleavings.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Model-specific mapping/simulation theorems and mechanized IMM results; published litmus counterexamples for mixing; corrected linearizability locality proof. These are stronger than a finite litmus pass but do not cover unmodeled optimizations or hardware behavior.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Compiler optimizer/backend author, atomic-library integrator or concurrent-object verifier.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Use a sequential protocol, stronger atomics/locks with an adequate proof, or a single consistent atomic mapping; choose a simpler model when it satisfies the required observations.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Concurrent interference or asynchronous interaction can affect externally visible results, or a translation changes atomic/event ordering.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Known non-trigger: Neither concurrent/asynchronous interference affecting visible results nor a translation change to atomic/event ordering is present; for example, the assessed computation is genuinely isolated and sequential with no such ordering change. Lower-cost option already recorded: A genuinely isolated sequential computation with no concurrent shared access can be checked in its sequential semantics; a weak-memory framework is unnecessary. Applicability and evidence limit: A small lock, direct interleaving argument or complete finite model check can cheaply establish the applicable declared concurrency relation. A simple program remains applicable if shared interference or changed atomic/event order affects the claim.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Named language/ISA memory models, atomic modes, race/undefined-behavior premises, graph consistency, compatible ABI mappings and explicit observation relation. Linearizability uses well-formed histories and a legal sequential object specification with corrected pending-operation handling.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Source concurrent semantics through modeled instruction mapping; actual hardware, arbitrary optimizations and mixed compiler/library versions need additional evidence.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Outcome/history refinement for the declared language/model pair and transformation fragment. Excludes: All DRF code being SC despite relaxed atomics, global liveness from safety, arbitrary compiler optimizations from IMM instruction-mapping proofs, or all actor/session semantics from one model.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Conditional semantic/mechanistic result. No universal mandate or legal authority is inferred.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Versioned source/target models, complete operation mappings, definedness/race assumptions, simulation/mapping proof or scoped counterexample, and mixed-unit configuration.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS: EPLT-C0104 rewrite side conditions become interference-sensitive; EPLT-C0110 requires atomic ABI compatibility; EPLT-C0113 adds fairness/liveness; EPLT-C0116 relates model to executed implementation.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: Plain data races may yield source UB rather than a well-defined litmus outcome. Mixing SC and weak accesses can invalidate a mapping argument. A history definition that ignores pending invocations can claim locality for the wrong relation.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: State/graph complexity, architecture/version-specific models and proofs, reduced optimization freedom or stronger synchronization overhead.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Recheck on memory model, atomic lowering, compiler options, architecture, synchronization library, race assumptions, observation granularity or history-definition revision.

EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.A: Concurrent interference or asynchronous interaction can affect externally visible results, or a translation changes atomic/event ordering.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.P: ∀eT∈Exec_MT(T). ∃eS∈Exec_MS(S). ObsT(eT) R ObsS(eS). For object linearizability separately: ∀H∈Hist(Obj). ∃H′ extending H, legal sequential S. complete(H′)≡process S ∧ <complete(H′) ⊆ <S. Neither relation implies fairness.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.E: Versioned source/target models, complete operation mappings, definedness/race assumptions, simulation/mapping proof or scoped counterexample, and mixed-unit configuration.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.VERDICT_RULE: Evaluate A (applicability), P (claim truth) and E (evidence adequacy) separately. A=FAIL gives INAPPLICABLE, never a vacuous pass. A=UNKNOWN or required E missing gives UNKNOWN. For A=PASS, sound proof/complete scoped check supports PASS; a valid scoped counterexample gives FAIL; timeout, unsupported features, heuristic failure or incomplete coverage give UNKNOWN. E=FAIL denotes a known mismatch between evidence and bearer, not automatic semantic falsity.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION: Researcher model-refinement formulation of mapping correctness; amended linearizability expression from Sela/Herlihy/Petrank2021 Definition4.1, distinguished from processor SC.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Memory outcomes or public operation histories as declared. Partial orders preserve independence information that one serialized trace can hide.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Versioned source/target models, complete operation mappings, definedness/race assumptions, simulation/mapping proof or scoped counterexample, and mixed-unit configuration.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Construct consistent execution graphs or a simulation proof; for finite histories search for legal sequential completion respecting real time; inspect model and lowering revisions.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Finite bounded graph/history checks can be decidable; universal unbounded concurrent-program refinement is not generally decidable.

POSITIVE_WITNESS.WITNESS: Constructed: SC atomic stores x=1/y=1 followed by opposite SC loads cannot both read initial0 because no total order respects both program orders and both read constraints. Amended linearizability accepts overlapping queue operations when a legal real-time-respecting order exists.

COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS.WITNESS: Published: MixTesting’s Armv7-load/Armv8-store mixture permits both0 despite each uniform mapping’s correctness. Published correction: a read returning1 before a later pending write1 is admitted by the literal old linearizability formula but rejected by the amended one. These are distinct failures.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Missing semantics/configuration, unsupported constructs or unavailable proof/check results leave the claim UNKNOWN. Missing evidence is not evidence that the guard is false. If A is already known true, an unestablished model, premise, proof or coverage leaves the operational judgment UNKNOWN through P/E; if a fact needed to decide A itself is unknown, report A=UNKNOWN. Only an established false A permits INAPPLICABLE.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: Neither concurrent/asynchronous interference affecting visible results nor a translation change to atomic/event ordering is present; for example, the assessed computation is genuinely isolated and sequential with no such ordering change.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: An incomplete observation map can produce a false assurance; conservative rejection can withhold a true claim. Neither is resolved by a favorable label.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Check a nonempty intended input/context class and actual successful executions; rejecting every input or observing nothing cannot establish usefulness.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Recheck on memory model, atomic lowering, compiler options, architecture, synchronization library, race assumptions, observation granularity or history-definition revision.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: State/graph complexity, architecture/version-specific models and proofs, reduced optimization freedom or stronger synchronization overhead. Cheaper path: A genuinely isolated sequential computation with no concurrent shared access can be checked in its sequential semantics; a weak-memory framework is unnecessary. A simple program remains applicable if shared interference or changed atomic/event order affects the claim.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Specified safety/outcome relation under exact model, mapping and definedness premises.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Elegant local or sequential reasoning is unreliable if the actual event/memory model, pending operations or composition ABI is omitted; model correctness is not hardware validation.

Published correction: a read returning1 before a later pending write1 is admitted by the literal old linearizability formula but rejected by the amended one. These are distinct failures.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: The normalized access-level enum contradicts the actual inspected portions in several records. SB034, SB039 and SB064 are labeled RELEVANT_SECTIONS_INSPECTED although each explicitly records only abstract/metadata access and failed body retrieval. Conversely SA030 is METADATA_ONLY even though its cited 1994 source theorem/definition sections were inspected; only the separately mentioned 1999 version was metadata-only. The aggregate access counts therefore are not counts of the stated source access. The explanatory normalization note does not repair an inaccurate machine value.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: No listed finding is not a guarantee of correctness; reviewers and their sampled documentary checks are described in the validation report.

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: State scheduling, memory and environment assumptions for each temporal guarantee
PROPERTY_FAMILIES: B14 Temporal meaning, progress and fairness

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Process semantics distinguish available transitions from complete system behavior. Linearizability’s nonblocking property concerns existence of a valid response extension, not scheduler progress. Weak-memory fairness work exposes internal propagation obligations; 2026 liveness rules extend helpful-transition/ranking reasoning to RA and Strong Coherence.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Safety; local progress; deadlock freedom; termination; starvation freedom; fairness; response property; helpful transition
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Reason about what eventually happens, not only whether an observed finite prefix avoids an error.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A well-typed or non-stuck component can wait forever; a fair thread scheduler can still admit forever-stale reads if internal memory propagation is unfair.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.LOCATOR: Guarded commands; synchronous I/O; §7.2 libraries; §7.4 buffering
Interleavings; causal independence; event structure configurations; relation to domains
§2 history semantics; legal sequential history; real-time order and locality

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Do not project current features, proof coverage or terminology backwards onto earlier versions.
GENEALOGY.RELATION_CLASS_EXPLANATION: Detailed dated historical/analytical edges are in genealogy_edges; this record summarizes qualified present evolution and does not claim every cited source influenced every other source.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Each liveness/progress statement needs its own trace quantifier and scheduling, memory and environment assumptions. Local progress, global deadlock freedom, starvation freedom and termination are distinct claims.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: possibly infinite execution trace under a scheduler, memory model and environment
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A well-typed or non-stuck component can wait forever; a fair thread scheduler can still admit forever-stale reads if internal memory propagation is unfair.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Define fair executions, include internal memory actions where needed, and prove response/termination through invariants and well-founded progress measures. Separate a safety relation from a temporal completion guarantee.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Declarative weak-memory fairness uses prefix-finiteness of appropriate coherence/from-read relations and corresponds to operational fairness in specified models. 2026 work adds helpful internal memory transitions and potential/ranking rules for RA/Strong Coherence examples.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Identify the precise premise that turns an allowed infinite wait into a required response, avoiding false assurance from a local safety theorem.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Fairness2021 proves model-specific operational/declarative correspondences and studies lock termination. The 2026 paper proves rule soundness and ticket-lock starvation freedom under its hypotheses; it does not establish bounded response time for arbitrary runtimes.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: A language/protocol verifier or optimizer whose claim includes completion, responsiveness or fair infinite behavior.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Finite sequential state machine, bounded timeout with explicitly weaker failure semantics, or safety-only claim when eventual service is not required.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: The desired result includes eventual response, global progress, termination or preservation of infinite-execution behavior.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Known non-trigger: The desired result includes none of eventual response, global progress, termination, or preservation of infinite-execution behavior; for example, only a finite-prefix safety property is claimed and no eventual-completion conclusion is drawn. Lower-cost option already recorded: For a terminating finite straight-line sequential computation, elementary bounded evaluation can establish completion without fairness machinery. Applicability and evidence limit: Completion of a deterministic finite straight-line computation can be established by adequate bounded execution or a direct finite argument, with coverage matching the claimed inputs and environment. This is PASS for an applicable termination claim. An unfinished finite prefix, sampled inputs or absent environment assumptions do not establish unbounded liveness and yield UNKNOWN for that wider claim.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Scheduler fairness notion, internal memory-propagation fairness, environment/peer responsiveness, enabledness rules and a valid well-founded ranking or response proof. Fairness does not impose a numeric latency bound.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: The modeled transition system and its fair infinite executions. Operating-system scheduling, network delivery and physical timing are outside unless explicitly related.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: The named response/progress property for traces satisfying all fairness and environment assumptions. Excludes: Real-time deadlines, unconditional termination of all well-typed programs, and implementation lock freedom from linearizability alone.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Conditional semantic/mechanistic result. No universal mandate or legal authority is inferred.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Transition model, exact temporal formula, enabledness/fairness assumptions, environment contract and invariant/ranking/response proof. Finite traces alone cannot establish an unbounded eventuality.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS: EPLT-C0112 supplies the execution model; EPLT-C0110 supplies peer/interface obligations; EPLT-C0116 supplies runtime scheduling/propagation correspondence; EPLT-C0114 changes can invalidate fairness assumptions.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: A writer runs once and a reader runs infinitely but repeatedly sees stale0 if memory fairness is absent; an environment never sends a required message; a scheduler never runs an enabled component.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Fairness-sensitive temporal proofs, infinite-state reasoning, ranking design and potential runtime synchronization/latency costs.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Revalidate when scheduling policy, memory model/fairness, environment obligations, synchronization, enabledness or progress measure changes.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: Each liveness/progress statement needs its own trace quantifier and scheduling, memory and environment assumptions. Local progress, global deadlock freedom, starvation freedom and termination are distinct claims.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: P program; M transition/memory model; infinite traces τ; predicates req,resp on trace positions; temporal G/F operators.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For all admitted infinite executions satisfying scheduler, memory and environment fairness; no universal statement over excluded unfair executions.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: possibly infinite execution trace under a scheduler, memory model and environment
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Linear-time eventuality over admitted complete traces; F means eventually with no fixed time bound. Fairness predicates restrict the execution domain rather than alter observed evidence.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Scheduler fairness notion, internal memory-propagation fairness, environment/peer responsiveness, enabledness rules and a valid well-founded ranking or response proof. Fairness does not impose a numeric latency bound.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: The desired result includes eventual response, global progress, termination or preservation of infinite-execution behavior.

EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.A: The desired result includes eventual response, global progress, termination or preservation of infinite-execution behavior.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.P: ∀τ∈Exec_M(P)∩FairSched∩FairMem∩Env. G(req ⇒ F resp). A termination claim substitutes F done and needs its own proof. Existence of a next step, or existence of one completing extension, does not imply this universal formula.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.E: Transition model, exact temporal formula, enabledness/fairness assumptions, environment contract and invariant/ranking/response proof. Finite traces alone cannot establish an unbounded eventuality.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.VERDICT_RULE: Evaluate A (applicability), P (claim truth) and E (evidence adequacy) separately. A=FAIL gives INAPPLICABLE, never a vacuous pass. A=UNKNOWN or required E missing gives UNKNOWN. For A=PASS, sound proof/complete scoped check supports PASS; a valid scoped counterexample gives FAIL; timeout, unsupported features, heuristic failure or incomplete coverage give UNKNOWN. E=FAIL denotes a known mismatch between evidence and bearer, not automatic semantic falsity.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION: Researcher temporal reconstruction informed by Fairness2021 and the 2026 response rules; not asserted as their literal theorem syntax.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Request, response and internal propagation events mapped from actual execution; a stuck trace and an unfairly delayed trace must not be silently dropped.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Transition model, exact temporal formula, enabledness/fairness assumptions, environment contract and invariant/ranking/response proof. Finite traces alone cannot establish an unbounded eventuality.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Check theorem assumptions and ranking/helpful-transition obligations; construct an admissible nonresponding infinite trace to refute the statement. Finite timeout is evidence only about a bounded response claim.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Finite-state temporal model checking can decide scoped formulas; unbounded-program liveness is generally undecidable. Fairness abstraction can over- or under-approximate.

POSITIVE_WITNESS.WITNESS: Source-grounded: the 2026 RA/Strong-Coherence reasoning proves ticket-lock starvation freedom for any number of threads under its specified fairness and ranking premises.

COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS.WITNESS: Source-grounded mechanism, small constructed trace: after x is written1, a scheduled reader repeatedly loads old0 forever; thread fairness holds, but omitted memory fairness allows nontermination. The 1990 linearizability paper explicitly permits implementations to block or deadlock despite its specification-level nonblocking property.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Missing semantics/configuration, unsupported constructs or unavailable proof/check results leave the claim UNKNOWN. Missing evidence is not evidence that the guard is false. If A is already known true, an unestablished model, premise, proof or coverage leaves the operational judgment UNKNOWN through P/E; if a fact needed to decide A itself is unknown, report A=UNKNOWN. Only an established false A permits INAPPLICABLE.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: The desired result includes none of eventual response, global progress, termination, or preservation of infinite-execution behavior; for example, only a finite-prefix safety property is claimed and no eventual-completion conclusion is drawn.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: An incomplete observation map can produce a false assurance; conservative rejection can withhold a true claim. Neither is resolved by a favorable label.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Check a nonempty intended input/context class and actual successful executions; rejecting every input or observing nothing cannot establish usefulness.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Revalidate when scheduling policy, memory model/fairness, environment obligations, synchronization, enabledness or progress measure changes.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Fairness-sensitive temporal proofs, infinite-state reasoning, ranking design and potential runtime synchronization/latency costs. Cheaper path: For a terminating finite straight-line sequential computation, elementary bounded evaluation can establish completion without fairness machinery. Applicability and evidence limit: Completion of a deterministic finite straight-line computation can be established by adequate bounded execution or a direct finite argument, with coverage matching the claimed inputs and environment. This is PASS for an applicable termination claim. An unfinished finite prefix, sampled inputs or absent environment assumptions do not establish unbounded liveness and yield UNKNOWN for that wider claim.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: The specified unbounded eventuality within the declared fair execution class; no deadline or availability-rate claim.

The 1990 linearizability paper explicitly permits implementations to block or deadlock despite its specification-level nonblocking property.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Fairness can hide precisely the executions that cause practical failures, and a safety/progress label can be inflated into an eventuality unsupported by the theorem.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.KNOWN_FAILURES_AND_MISUSES: Source-grounded mechanism, small constructed trace: after x is written1, a scheduled reader repeatedly loads old0 forever; thread fairness holds, but omitted memory fairness allows nontermination. The 1990 linearizability paper explicitly permits implementations to block or deadlock despite its specification-level nonblocking property.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RESPONSE_OR_DESCENDANT_FORM: Declarative weak-memory fairness uses prefix-finiteness of appropriate coherence/from-read relations and corresponds to operational fairness in specified models. 2026 work adds helpful internal memory transitions and potential/ranking rules for RA/Strong Coherence examples.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.WHAT_CHANGED_AND_WHAT_DID_NOT: Explicit memory fairness and helpful-transition rules close a genuine logical gap for specified models; they do not establish external scheduling promises or latency bounds.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.CEREMONY_VERSUS_MECHANISM: A progress/deadlock-free label without the exact conclusion, fairness class and environment contract is not enough to justify responsiveness.
CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.RETENTION_RATIONALE: Retain temporal guarantees with explicit premises; prevent safety-to-liveness promotion and vacuous exclusion of relevant executions.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE.LIMITS: Whether real environments satisfy assumptions, proof scalability and fair-transformation preservation beyond the studied models.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.CLAIM: Scheduler fairness notion, internal memory-propagation fairness, environment/peer responsiveness, enabledness rules and a valid well-founded ranking or response proof. Fairness does not impose a numeric latency bound.
ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.LIMITS: A writer runs once and a reader runs infinitely but repeatedly sees stale0 if memory fairness is absent; an environment never sends a required message; a scheduler never runs an enabled component.

SEMANTIC_DEFINITION_ADEQUACY.CLAIM: Request, response and internal propagation events mapped from actual execution; a stuck trace and an unfairly delayed trace must not be silently dropped.
SEMANTIC_DEFINITION_ADEQUACY.LIMITS: Whether real environments satisfy assumptions, proof scalability and fair-transformation preservation beyond the studied models.

METATHEORETIC_GUARANTEE.CLAIM: ∀τ∈Exec_M(P)∩FairSched∩FairMem∩Env. G(req ⇒ F resp). A termination claim substitutes F done and needs its own proof. Existence of a next step, or existence of one completing extension, does not imply this universal formula.
METATHEORETIC_GUARANTEE.LIMITS: The specified unbounded eventuality within the declared fair execution class; no deadline or availability-rate claim.

CHECKER_COMPILER_TRUST.CLAIM: Sound temporal proof/model checker and faithful operational/declarative fairness correspondence; execution platform must satisfy modeled fairness separately.
CHECKER_COMPILER_TRUST.LIMITS: Research inspected stated boundaries; proof replay and executable certification were not performed.

IMPLEMENTATION_CORRESPONDENCE.CLAIM: The inspected liveness results establish semantic model theorems and examples, not a production OS/memory system’s unconditional scheduling contract.
IMPLEMENTATION_CORRESPONDENCE.LIMITS: Whether real environments satisfy assumptions, proof scalability and fair-transformation preservation beyond the studied models.

TRANSFORMATION_COVERAGE.CLAIM: The named response/progress property for traces satisfying all fairness and environment assumptions.
TRANSFORMATION_COVERAGE.LIMITS: Real-time deadlines, unconditional termination of all well-typed programs, and implementation lock freedom from linearizability alone.

EMPIRICAL_USABILITY.CLAIM: No distinct evidence of this kind was located for this precise candidate.
EMPIRICAL_USABILITY.LIMITS: Absence from this research is not evidence of absence.

NATURAL_LANGUAGE_DOMAIN_CORRESPONDENCE.LIMITS: Intent/model correspondence requires additional evidence beyond this mechanism.

EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.EVIDENCE_CEILING: The specified unbounded eventuality within the declared fair execution class; no deadline or availability-rate claim.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.TRANSFERABILITY_LIMITS: Applicable to another language/tool only after re-establishing its semantics, relation, assumptions and implementation correspondence.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.UNVERIFIED_OR_OPEN_QUESTIONS: Connecting abstract fairness to deployed scheduling/memory behavior and extending compositional liveness to richer mixed-language systems.
EVIDENCE_AND_UNCERTAINTY.NEXT_DISCRIMINATOR: Remove only memory fairness while preserving thread fairness and search for a forever-stale read; remove peer responsiveness and inspect whether the theorem still claims completion.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: The normalized access-level enum contradicts the actual inspected portions in several records. SB034, SB039 and SB064 are labeled RELEVANT_SECTIONS_INSPECTED although each explicitly records only abstract/metadata access and failed body retrieval. Conversely SA030 is METADATA_ONLY even though its cited 1994 source theorem/definition sections were inspected; only the separately mentioned 1999 version was metadata-only. The aggregate access counts therefore are not counts of the stated source access. The explanatory normalization note does not repair an inaccurate machine value.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: No listed finding is not a guarantee of correctness; reviewers and their sampled documentary checks are described in the validation report.

INTAKE.CROSSWALK_ELIGIBILITY_WITH_REASON: ELIGIBLE_AS_GUARDED_QUESTION: mechanism and discriminators can inform later evidence intake; not a target adoption decision.
TARGET_NEUTRAL_AUDIT_QUESTIONS: What exact temporal formula is proved?
Which actions, including propagation, are subject to fairness?
How is the real environment known to meet those assumptions?
PROHIBITED_OVERCLAIMS: Progress means every request eventually completes.
A fair scheduler suffices for all weak-memory liveness.
Linearizable means lock-free.
Eventual response supplies a finite deadline.
INTAKE.SYNTHESIS_RELEVANT_INTERFACES: EPLT-C0112 supplies the execution model; EPLT-C0110 supplies peer/interface obligations; EPLT-C0116 supplies runtime scheduling/propagation correspondence; EPLT-C0114 changes can invalidate fairness assumptions.

CONCURRENT_TEMPORAL_SEMANTICS_PROFILE.EXECUTION_MODEL: Complete finite/infinite transition traces with explicitly modeled memory actions.
CONCURRENT_TEMPORAL_SEMANTICS_PROFILE.OBSERVED_BEHAVIOUR: Named safety/eventuality formula; no implicit strengthening.
CONCURRENT_TEMPORAL_SEMANTICS_PROFILE.SCHEDULING_MEMORY_ASSUMPTIONS: Separate scheduler, propagation and environment fairness; exact enabledness.
CONCURRENT_TEMPORAL_SEMANTICS_PROFILE.COMPOSITIONAL_GUARANTEE: Only when peer, model and transformation premises preserve the temporal relation.
CONCURRENT_TEMPORAL_SEMANTICS_PROFILE.EXCLUDED_FAILURES: Unfair executions/failed peers only as stated; timing deadlines and arbitrary runtime failures remain outside.

records.title: Define compatibility as an explicit relation over versions, consumers and observations

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Define compatibility as an explicit relation over versions, consumers and observations
PROPERTY_FAMILIES: B20 Language, schema and IR evolution

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Language migrations such as Python’s division change exposed the gap between unchanged grammar and unchanged meaning. Semantic Versioning specifies a declared-API convention. Protobuf and LLVM articulate distinct wire/IR compatibility policies; evolving mechanized Wasm developments show proof/artifact currency is another dimension.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Backward/forward compatibility; migration; deprecation; version negotiation; wire safety; semantic versioning; replay
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Signal and manage breaking changes so consumers can coordinate upgrades and preserve intended uses.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A parsable old artifact, unchanged source string or compatible wire encoding can change behavior or invalidate proofs; version labels cannot themselves establish semantic compatibility.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.LOCATOR: Classic/true/floor division; future directive and migration warnings
Rules 1, 3, 6–8, 10; public API and immutable releases

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Do not project current features, proof coverage or terminology backwards onto earlier versions.
GENEALOGY.RELATION_CLASS_EXPLANATION: Detailed dated historical/analytical edges are in genealogy_edges; this record summarizes qualified present evolution and does not claim every cited source influenced every other source.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Compatibility must name the version pair, direction, consumer class and preserved observations/obligations. Migration or deliberate breakage requires revalidation of those claims, independently of syntax and version numbering.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: old/new language or schema versions, migration and affected consumer/evidence obligations
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A parsable old artifact, unchanged source string or compatible wire encoding can change behavior or invalidate proofs; version labels cannot themselves establish semantic compatibility.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Specify a migration/upgrade relation, preserve historical version identity, identify changed defaults and dependencies, and test/prove consumer-specific obligations across mixed-version states.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Explicit feature/edition negotiation, staged rollout restrictions, reserved schema identifiers, IR-upgrade policies and proof-maintenance architectures distinguish several meanings of compatibility.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Avoid silent reinterpretation and identify which consumers/evidence must change, without requiring all future semantics to preserve every old behavior.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: PEP238 gives a concrete same-syntax meaning change and migration mechanisms. Protobuf documents wire-compatible changes that still break generated code or truncate values. LLVM explicitly distinguishes textual IR and bitcode commitments. These normative cases establish mechanisms, not a universal quantified migration theorem.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Library/language/schema maintainers and downstream consumers deciding whether old artifacts and evidence remain valid.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Freeze the old interpreter/schema, reject unknown versions, use an explicit breaking-version boundary, or manually migrate a small finite artifact population.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A language, IR, schema, library, default, runtime or toolchain changes while old source/data/artifacts or evidence remain in use.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Known non-trigger: No change is being judged while old source, data, artifacts or evidence remain in use, and no old-to-new compatibility obligation is claimed; for example, all old artifacts are actually retired and only a fresh single-version claim is assessed. Lower-cost option already recorded: For a small isolated disposable artifact set, regenerate and recheck everything under one version; sophisticated mixed-version compatibility machinery may cost more than full migration. Applicability and evidence limit: Full regeneration and rechecking can remove a reuse obligation once old artifacts and claims are actually retired. If old-to-new compatibility is still required, A remains true; checking the new version alone does not prove the required old-to-new observation relation.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Old/new version identities are stable; relevant consumers and observations are declared; the migration relation handles admitted artifacts; rollout restrictions and environment/library dependencies are followed.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: Specified version pair and consumer class, including generated code, wire data, old readers/new writers and any proof/checker artifacts.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Syntactic acceptance, wire decoding, semantic behavior and evidence validity are separately named relations; only the chosen ones are required. Excludes: Automatic compatibility from a major/minor label, universal old/new interoperability, or preservation of obsolete behavior when a deliberate documented breaking change is intended.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Conditional semantic/mechanistic result. No universal mandate or legal authority is inferred.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Exact semantic/schema/tool versions; changed-default inventory; consumers/rollout states; migration definition and property-specific tests/proofs; separately current evidence/checker versions.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS: EPLT-C0110 interface/context changes; EPLT-C0115 evidence invalidation; EPLT-C0101 IR identity; EPLT-C0116 runtime semantics; EPLT-C0106/EPLT-C0111 theorem/artifact version matching.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: Same expression 3/2 returns integer1 under Python2 classic integer division and1.5 under Python3 true division. Adding an enum value can be wire-safe yet break exhaustive consumer source; widening protobuf int32 to int64 can truncate for old readers.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Consumer inventory, migration tools/tests, mixed-version rollout and retained historical artifacts; stronger compatibility can constrain language improvement.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Re-evaluate on any semantic dependency/default/feature-policy change; retire old evidence explicitly rather than rewriting its historical meaning. A syntactic edit need not invalidate a property if a relevant invariance proof exists.

ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.INTENDED_MEANING: The exact old/new artifacts and which users must continue to work.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.BEARER_OR_OBJECT_TYPE: The old/new language or schema versions, migration and affected consumer/evidence obligations
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.ALLOWED_VALUES_OR_CONSTRAINTS: Tuple {old,new,direction,consumer class,observation relation}
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.OBSERVED_DERIVED_ASSUMED_OR_STIPULATED: Derived from named semantic definitions and observed configuration; premises separately marked assumed.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.MEASUREMENT_OR_DERIVATION_METHOD: Read version policy and enumerate old-reader/new-writer and old-source/new-tool cases.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.SOURCE_OR_WITNESS: EPLT-SB044 rules; EPLT-SB046 updating message types; EPLT-SB059 IR policy
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.RESOLUTION_AND_UNCERTAINTY: Only the specified artifact/version and claim; uninspected implementation details remain unknown.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.MISSING_UNKNOWN_NOT_APPLICABLE_DISTINCTI: MISSING = no supplied record; UNKNOWN = present but not enough to determine the value; NOT_APPLICABLE = guard excludes this bearer. None means false by default.

ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.DEPENDENT_ATTRIBUTES: Semantic version, observation relation, configuration and the other attribute in this record.
ATTRIBUTE_SCHEMA.CHANGE_IMPACT: A different consumer or direction can reverse compatibility.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: Compatibility must name the version pair, direction, consumer class and preserved observations/obligations. Migration or deliberate breakage requires revalidation of those claims, independently of syntax and version numbering.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: Versioned semantics and schemas; admitted old programs/data; partial migration map; contexts/readers; specified relation R.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: Every admitted old artifact and declared consumer combination for which compatibility is promised; direction and rollout phase explicit.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: old/new language or schema versions, migration and affected consumer/evidence obligations
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Whole execution behavior unless the explicit relation below restricts the observation to states or finite traces.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Old/new version identities are stable; relevant consumers and observations are declared; the migration relation handles admitted artifacts; rollout restrictions and environment/library dependencies are followed.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A language, IR, schema, library, default, runtime or toolchain changes while old source/data/artifacts or evidence remain in use.

EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.A: A language, IR, schema, library, default, runtime or toolchain changes while old source/data/artifacts or evidence remain in use.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.P: ∀p∈AdmittedOld ∀C∈Consumers. Defined(migrate(p),C) ∧ ObsNew(C,migrate(p)) R ObsOld(C,p). SyntaxAccepted or WireDecodable is a weaker separate predicate; a version label is evidence of a policy commitment, not a proof of this formula.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.E: Exact semantic/schema/tool versions; changed-default inventory; consumers/rollout states; migration definition and property-specific tests/proofs; separately current evidence/checker versions.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.VERDICT_RULE: Evaluate A (applicability), P (claim truth) and E (evidence adequacy) separately. A=FAIL gives INAPPLICABLE, never a vacuous pass. A=UNKNOWN or required E missing gives UNKNOWN. For A=PASS, sound proof/complete scoped check supports PASS; a valid scoped counterexample gives FAIL; timeout, unsupported features, heuristic failure or incomplete coverage give UNKNOWN. E=FAIL denotes a known mismatch between evidence and bearer, not automatic semantic falsity.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION: Researcher operational compatibility obligation synthesized from official migration/version policies; not attributed as a proved universal theorem to those documents.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: Chosen decoded value, generated-client behavior, result/exception/I/O or formal invariant; successful parsing and unchanged bytes are recorded separately.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Exact semantic/schema/tool versions; changed-default inventory; consumers/rollout states; migration definition and property-specific tests/proofs; separately current evidence/checker versions.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Compare meanings in old/new environments; exercise mixed-version consumers and boundary values; check whether existing theorem assumptions are still true. Unknown consumers mean unknown general compatibility.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Finite schema/consumer checks can be decidable; arbitrary program semantic equivalence is not. Migration testing establishes only its covered scope.

POSITIVE_WITNESS.WITNESS: Source-grounded: PEP238 provides an explicit future-division transition and // for intentional floor division. Protobuf’s staged integer widening restricts writers until all readers can represent larger values.

COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS.WITNESS: Published normative examples: wire-safe enum addition can break exhaustive generated-client handling; old int32 readers can truncate newly permitted int64 values. Constructed stale proof: a proof using floor division is reused for identical text under true division.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Missing semantics/configuration, unsupported constructs or unavailable proof/check results leave the claim UNKNOWN. Missing evidence is not evidence that the guard is false. If A is already known true, an unestablished model, premise, proof or coverage leaves the operational judgment UNKNOWN through P/E; if a fact needed to decide A itself is unknown, report A=UNKNOWN. Only an established false A permits INAPPLICABLE.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No change is being judged while old source, data, artifacts or evidence remain in use, and no old-to-new compatibility obligation is claimed; for example, all old artifacts are actually retired and only a fresh single-version claim is assessed.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: An incomplete observation map can produce a false assurance; conservative rejection can withhold a true claim. Neither is resolved by a favorable label.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Check a nonempty intended input/context class and actual successful executions; rejecting every input or observing nothing cannot establish usefulness.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Re-evaluate on any semantic dependency/default/feature-policy change; retire old evidence explicitly rather than rewriting its historical meaning. A syntactic edit need not invalidate a property if a relevant invariance proof exists.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Consumer inventory, migration tools/tests, mixed-version rollout and retained historical artifacts; stronger compatibility can constrain language improvement. Cheaper path: For a small isolated disposable artifact set, regenerate and recheck everything under one version; sophisticated mixed-version compatibility machinery may cost more than full migration. Applicability and evidence limit: Full regeneration and rechecking can remove a reuse obligation once old artifacts and claims are actually retired. If old-to-new compatibility is still required, A remains true; checking the new version alone does not prove the required old-to-new observation relation.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVIDENCE_CEILING: Documented policy and consumer-specific checked/proved relation, not universal semantics preservation from release labels.

ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.FORMALISATION_PROVENANCE: Researcher operational compatibility obligation synthesized from official migration/version policies; not attributed as a proved universal theorem to those documents.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.OPERATIONAL_EVALUATION: Compare meanings in old/new environments; exercise mixed-version consumers and boundary values; check whether existing theorem assumptions are still true. Unknown consumers mean unknown general compatibility. No target implementation was supplied or certified by this research. A/P/E are evaluation obligations, not computed owner-system scores. Applicability clarification: INAPPLICABLE only when No change is being judged while old source, data, artifacts or evidence remain in use, and no old-to-new compatibility obligation is claimed; for example, all old artifacts are actually retired and only a fresh single-version claim is assessed. Cheap-path judgment: Full regeneration and rechecking can remove a reuse obligation once old artifacts and claims are actually retired. If old-to-new compatibility is still required, A remains true; checking the new version alone does not prove the required old-to-new observation relation. Missing evidence is not evidence that the guard is false. If A is already known true, an unestablished model, premise, proof or coverage leaves the operational judgment UNKNOWN through P/E; if a fact needed to decide A itself is unknown, report A=UNKNOWN. Only an established false A permits INAPPLICABLE.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.POSITIVE_WITNESS_OR_WORKED_EXAMPLE: Source-grounded: PEP238 provides an explicit future-division transition and // for intentional floor division. Protobuf’s staged integer widening restricts writers until all readers can represent larger values.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.NEGATIVE_WITNESS_OR_COUNTEREXAMPLE: Published normative examples: wire-safe enum addition can break exhaustive generated-client handling; old int32 readers can truncate newly permitted int64 values. Constructed stale proof: a proof using floor division is reused for identical text under true division.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.NON_TRIGGER_EXAMPLE: No change is being judged while old source, data, artifacts or evidence remain in use, and no old-to-new compatibility obligation is claimed; for example, all old artifacts are actually retired and only a fresh single-version claim is assessed.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.OBSERVABILITY_AND_MISSINGNESS: Missing semantics/configuration, unsupported constructs or unavailable proof/check results leave the claim UNKNOWN.
ATTRIBUTES_AND_PREDICATES.CURRENTNESS_AND_INVALIDATION: Re-evaluate on any semantic dependency/default/feature-policy change; retire old evidence explicitly rather than rewriting its historical meaning. A syntactic edit need not invalidate a property if a relevant invariance proof exists.

CRITICISM_AND_EVOLUTION.STRONGEST_OBJECTION: Semantic Versioning and grammar/schema compatibility can communicate useful constraints while leaving the actual consumer’s semantics unproved; preserving everything can also block legitimate evolution.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: The normalized access-level enum contradicts the actual inspected portions in several records. SB034, SB039 and SB064 are labeled RELEVANT_SECTIONS_INSPECTED although each explicitly records only abstract/metadata access and failed body retrieval. Conversely SA030 is METADATA_ONLY even though its cited 1994 source theorem/definition sections were inspected; only the separately mentioned 1999 version was metadata-only. The aggregate access counts therefore are not counts of the stated source access. The explanatory normalization note does not repair an inaccurate machine value.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.

REVIEW_FINDINGS_AND_DISPOSITION.LIMIT: No listed finding is not a guarantee of correctness; reviewers and their sampled documentary checks are described in the validation report.

records.title: Reuse a result only across complete relevant dependencies or a proved invariant change

IDENTITY.PROPERTY_NAME: Reuse a result only across complete relevant dependencies or a proved invariant change
PROPERTY_FAMILIES: B20 Incremental analysis and cached evidence

GENEALOGY.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: Build-system research separates scheduling from rebuilding and states correctness against recomputation. Incremental compilers track query dependencies and use red/green output stability to avoid unnecessary invalidation; semantic evolution makes implicit version/context dependencies material.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_TERMINOLOGY: Dependency graph; dynamic dependency; constructive/verifying trace; content addressing; red-green algorithm; fingerprint
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_FORM: Avoid recomputation when inputs relevant to the requested result have not changed, while ensuring the resulting store agrees with fresh execution.
GENEALOGY.ORIGINAL_PROBLEM: A cache key can match the artifact text while omitting a changed compiler flag, library body, semantics, environment or negative/dynamic dependency; cached evidence then concerns the wrong evaluation.

HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE_AND_LOCATORS.LOCATOR: Definition 3.1 correctness; §4 trace rebuilders; §6 nondeterminism/cycles

GENEALOGY.DISPUTED_ATTRIBUTION_OR_ANACHRONISM_RISK: Do not project current features, proof coverage or terminology backwards onto earlier versions.
GENEALOGY.RELATION_CLASS_EXPLANATION: Detailed dated historical/analytical edges are in genealogy_edges; this record summarizes qualified present evolution and does not claim every cited source influenced every other source.

CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Reuse is justified by unchanged relevant semantic dependencies or a proved preservation relation, not merely identical source bytes or a cache hit. Complete recomputation is an adequate conservative fallback when dependency evidence is weak.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.BEARER_OR_SUBJECT: cached build/analysis/proof result, its dependency graph and current semantic evaluation context
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.FAILURE_MODE_OR_LIMIT_ADDRESSED: A cache key can match the artifact text while omitting a changed compiler flag, library body, semantics, environment or negative/dynamic dependency; cached evidence then concerns the wrong evaluation.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MECHANISM: Record all dependencies consumed by a deterministic evaluation, compare stable identities/values, and propagate invalidation; recomputation can establish unchanged output even after an input changed. Include model/evaluator/configuration identities in evidence claims.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Dynamic dependency discovery and red-green output comparison refine coarse timestamp rebuilding. Content hashes provide identity for recorded inputs but do not discover omitted dependencies.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.EXPECTED_PAYOFF: Save work while preserving the result that a fresh current evaluation would provide; avoid both stale results and unnecessary invalidation.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.PAYOFF_EVIDENCE_NOT_JUST_RATIONALE: Build Systems à la Carte Definition3.1 makes recomputation consistency explicit for its model. Rust documentation describes practical query dependency tracking and red-green checks. Neither proves an arbitrary user cache has complete dependencies.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Build/analysis engine or assessor reusing earlier semantic evidence.
CLAIM_AND_MECHANISM.ALTERNATIVE_MECHANISMS: Recompute fully; invalidate conservatively on any toolchain/environment change; restrict evaluation to a hermetic finite interface; independently validate the reused result.

APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: A previous result is accepted as evidence for a current artifact/context without performing the entire evaluation again.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Known non-trigger: No prior result is accepted without performing the entire required evaluation again; for example, the old cache is discarded and the assessed result is obtained by complete fresh recomputation. Lower-cost option already recorded: If recomputation is inexpensive or dependency completeness is uncertain, discard the cache entry and recompute; an elaborate invalidation framework is unnecessary. Applicability and evidence limit: Fresh recomputation is a true no-trigger route when no reused result is accepted. Cheap checks of a reused result can instead establish P if they cover every relevant dependency and the required fresh-result relation. The mere availability of recomputation does not make actual reuse inapplicable.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ASSUMPTIONS_AND_PRECONDITIONS: Deterministic/pure or explicitly modeled nondeterministic task semantics; complete dependency recording including dynamic/negative/environment inputs; stable identity scheme and no unaccounted hash collision; unchanged evaluator/model or a proved invariant change.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.ENVIRONMENT_AND_BOUNDARY: The task/query semantics and dependency closure captured by the build/analysis model. Filesystem content alone may not capture flags, tool semantics, external resources or ambient state.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.SCOPE_AND_EXCLUSIONS: Equality or stated equivalence of the current result to fresh evaluation; not proof that the evaluator’s proposition is true. Excludes: Correctness of an unsound checker, source intent, reproducibility from unspecified ambient state, and semantic equality merely from equal hashes of an incomplete input set.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.AUTHORITY_OR_NORMATIVE_BASIS_IF_APPLICAB: Conditional semantic/mechanistic result. No universal mandate or legal authority is inferred.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.INPUT_AND_EVIDENCE_PROVENANCE_REQUIREMEN: Result and evaluator identities; complete tracked dependencies; current dependency values/versions; stable fingerprint assumptions; dynamic/negative dependency handling or fresh recomputation evidence.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.DEPENDENCIES_AND_CONFLICTS: EPLT-C0114 supplies version/semantic change; EPLT-C0103 and EPLT-C0108 and EPLT-C0109 results include analyzer/validator/checker premises; EPLT-C0106 and EPLT-C0107 and EPLT-C0116 compiled artifacts include tool/runtime configurations.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.FAILURE_OF_ASSUMPTIONS: Caller source hash unchanged while inlined library body or overflow/fast-math option changes; reuse retains a proof for an old semantics. Stable output despite a changed input can conversely make blanket invalidation wasteful.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.COST_AND_MAINTENANCE_BURDEN: Dependency storage/tracing, stable hashing, validation and graph maintenance; conservative invalidation spends computation but reduces dependency-completeness burden.
APPLICABILITY_AND_AUTHORITY.RETIREMENT_OR_REENTRY_CONDITION: Invalidate when any relevant dependency or evaluator/model premise changes unless equivalence is re-established; missing dependency history gives UNKNOWN and calls for recomputation.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.NAME_AND_PLAIN_LANGUAGE_CLAIM: Reuse is justified by unchanged relevant semantic dependencies or a proved preservation relation, not merely identical source bytes or a cache hit. Complete recomputation is an adequate conservative fallback when dependency evidence is weak.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VARIABLE_DOMAINS_AND_UNITS: Eval deterministic semantic query; contexts contain all observed inputs; Deps complete dependency closure; result and evidence identity.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.QUANTIFIERS_AND_SCOPE: For the specific cached result and all inputs that can affect it under the named evaluator; not arbitrary future changes.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.STATE_TRACE_EVENT_OR_MODEL_BEARER: cached build/analysis/proof result, its dependency graph and current semantic evaluation context
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.TEMPORAL_AND_MODAL_SEMANTICS: Whole execution behavior unless the explicit relation below restricts the observation to states or finite traces.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.ASSUMPTIONS: Deterministic/pure or explicitly modeled nondeterministic task semantics; complete dependency recording including dynamic/negative/environment inputs; stable identity scheme and no unaccounted hash collision; unchanged evaluator/model or a proved invariant change.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.APPLICABILITY_GUARD: A previous result is accepted as evidence for a current artifact/context without performing the entire evaluation again.

EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.A: A previous result is accepted as evidence for a current artifact/context without performing the entire evaluation again.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.P: CompleteDeps(Eval,old,new,Deps) ∧ SameRelevantInputs(old,new,Deps) ∧ SameEvaluatorSemantics ⇒ Eval(new)=Eval(old)=result. Alternatively a proved invariant-change relation may establish the same equality. CacheHit alone is insufficient.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.E: Result and evaluator identities; complete tracked dependencies; current dependency values/versions; stable fingerprint assumptions; dynamic/negative dependency handling or fresh recomputation evidence.
EXPRESSION_OR_PRECISE_OPERATIONAL_RULE.VERDICT_RULE: Evaluate A (applicability), P (claim truth) and E (evidence adequacy) separately. A=FAIL gives INAPPLICABLE, never a vacuous pass. A=UNKNOWN or required E missing gives UNKNOWN. For A=PASS, sound proof/complete scoped check supports PASS; a valid scoped counterexample gives FAIL; timeout, unsupported features, heuristic failure or incomplete coverage give UNKNOWN. E=FAIL denotes a known mismatch between evidence and bearer, not automatic semantic falsity.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.SOURCE_OF_THE_EXPRESSION: Researcher reuse rule specialized from Build Systems à la Carte recomputation correctness and Rust’s described red-green mechanism; full dependency completeness is an explicit premise.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.OBSERVATION_OR_MEASUREMENT_MAP: The result value/proposition with all assumptions, not just output byte identity when the intended claim depends on external semantics.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.REQUIRED_EVIDENCE: Result and evaluator identities; complete tracked dependencies; current dependency values/versions; stable fingerprint assumptions; dynamic/negative dependency handling or fresh recomputation evidence.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.EVALUATOR_OR_REASONING_PROCEDURE: Inspect dependency graph and purity assumptions; perturb a semantic input not in the apparent key; recompute and compare. A graph audit cannot generally prove absence of every hidden ambient input.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.DECIDABILITY_AND_APPROXIMATION: Finite recorded graph identity is decidable; general semantic dependency completeness/equivalence is not. Conservative invalidation is sound only with sufficiently broad covered inputs.

POSITIVE_WITNESS.WITNESS: Source-grounded mechanism: a changed input causes a Rust query to run, but unchanged query output can remain green so dependent results are reused without treating the input edit itself as semantic change.

COUNTEREXAMPLE_OR_FAILURE_WITNESS.WITNESS: Constructed: a nonzero/division-safety result cached by caller text is reused after an inlined library function changes from returning1 to returning0. Every recorded caller hash matches, but the missing dependency changes the truth of the claim.

PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.UNKNOWN_CONDITIONS: Missing semantics/configuration, unsupported constructs or unavailable proof/check results leave the claim UNKNOWN. Missing evidence is not evidence that the guard is false. If A is already known true, an unestablished model, premise, proof or coverage leaves the operational judgment UNKNOWN through P/E; if a fact needed to decide A itself is unknown, report A=UNKNOWN. Only an established false A permits INAPPLICABLE.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS: No prior result is accepted without performing the entire required evaluation again; for example, the old cache is discarded and the assessed result is obtained by complete fresh recomputation.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.FALSE_POSITIVE_AND_FALSE_NEGATIVE_RISKS: An incomplete observation map can produce a false assurance; conservative rejection can withhold a true claim. Neither is resolved by a favorable label.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.VACUITY_OR_PROXY_GAMING_RISKS: Check a nonempty intended input/context class and actual successful executions; rejecting every input or observing nothing cannot establish usefulness.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.CHANGE_INVALIDATION_RULE: Invalidate when any relevant dependency or evaluator/model premise changes unless equivalence is re-established; missing dependency history gives UNKNOWN and calls for recomputation.
PREDICATE_SPECIFICATIONS.COST_AND_CHEAPER_ALTERNATIVE: Dependency storage/tracing, stable hashing, validation and graph maintenance; conservative invalidation spends computation but reduces dependency-completeness burden. Cheaper path: If recomputation is inexpensive or dependency completeness is uncertain, discard the cache entry and recompute; an elaborate invalidation framework is unnecessary. Applicability and evidence limit: Fresh recomputation is a true no-trigger route when no reused result is accepted. Cheap checks of a reused result can instead establish P if they cover every relevant dependency and the required fresh-result relation. The mere availability of recomputation does not make actual reuse inapplicable.

RELEVANT_FINDINGS.FINDING: The normalized access-level enum contradicts the actual inspected portions in several records. SB034, SB039 and SB064 are labeled RELEVANT_SECTIONS_INSPECTED although each explicitly records only abstract/metadata access and failed body retrieval. Conversely SA030 is METADATA_ONLY even though its cited 1994 source theorem/definition sections were inspected; only the separately mentioned 1999 version was metadata-only. The aggregate access counts therefore are not counts of the stated source access. The explanatory normalization note does not repair an inaccurate machine value.

Several fields named INAPPLICABILITY_CONDITIONS contain only a cheaper sufficient method, although the record’s applicability guard remains true. A known source/target identity pair still meets C0108’s need for a checked preservation relation; direct equality can satisfy it cheaply. A finite straight-line computation whose completion is required still meets C0113’s eventuality/termination guard; bounded evaluation may prove it without fairness machinery. A small interpreter still falls under C0116 if the assurance claim concerns the executing runtime. Mapping these conditions to INAPPLICABLE conflicts with the declared A/P/E rule that only a known false guard yields that outcome, and can erase an applicable obligation precisely because it already has a proportionate mechanism.
